tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs/

na mo ār+ya mañdzu shrī ye/ gser mngal can dang mgrin sngon pad dkar mig /mig stong ldan dang lus med bdag po dang*/ /rgyu skar rgyal po pad+mo'i gnyen sogs kyis/ /zhabs pad gus bsten thub dbang de la 'dud/ /rgyal ba de yi bstan pa 'phags bod du/ /ji ltar byung tshul rgyal rabs dang 'brel bar/ /snga phyir dam pa'i skyes bu rim byon gyi/ /chos 'byung mtshon tsam dad pas bri bar bya/ /de la gsum/ sngon tshe 'phags yul du rgyal rabs ji ltar byon tshul dang*/ de'i rjes su ji ltar byon tshul dang*/ bod du byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal rabs ni rgya cher rol pa/ mngon 'byung*/ 'dul ba lung*/ 'jig rten bzhag pa sogs nas bshad cing de dag la ming mi 'dra ba dang rgyas bsdus kyang cung zad mi 'dra ba re 'byung zhing*/ 'dir 'dul ba lung las 'byung ba ltar bsdus te brjod na/ bskal ba dang po'i mi rnams ni brdzus skyes tshe lo dpag tu med pa thub cing*/ dga' ba zas su za ba/ rang lus 'od dang ldan pa sogs khyad par du ma yod pa las/ phyes tshe dang las stobs rim gyis bri ste lus kyi 'od nyams pa na/ sems can spyi mthun gyi las kyis nyi zla rgyu skar rnams byung*/ de rjes ma rmos pa'i lo tog byung ba'i tshe rku 'phrog byas pa la brten nas/ sems can de dag mang po gros byas te skyes bu bsod nams dang ldan pa zhig rgyal por bskos pas/ de la mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po zhes grags so/ /de'i bu 'od mdzes/ de'i bu dge ba/ de'i bu dge mchog /de'i gso sbyong 'phags/ de'i bu spyi bor phol mig las nga las nu byung ste/ de ni gling gzhir dbang ba'i rgyal po/ /rgyal po nga las nu'i brla g.yas par phol mig las mdzes pa/ g.yon pa'i phol mig las nye mdzes skyes te snga mas gling gsum dang*/ phyi mas gling gny-is la dbang sgyur/ nye mdzes kyi rkang ba'i bol gyi phol mig las mdzes can byung ste/

des gling gcig la dbang bsgyur/ 'di dus mi rnams ni tshe lo bzhi khri re thub cing*/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig byon par bshad do/ /nye mdzes kyi rkang mthil las phol mig zhig byung ba las mdzes ldan te/ de yang gling gcig la dbang ngo*/ /de nas gzhan zhig las mdzes ldan gyi bu ni btang ba'o/ /de'i bu ni btang bzung ngo zhes 'byung yang*/ 'dul ba lung las mdzes ldan gyi rjes su rim pa bzhin du/ rgyas byed dang*/ sred pa dang*/ nye sred dang*/ btang ba dang*/ btang bzung dang*/ lus thul dang*/ shes ldan dang*/ ngan spong dang*/ shing rta sdu gu can dang*/ dug can dang*/ dug can chen po dang*/ ku sha ni dang*/ ku sha ni chen po dang*/ ku shi dang*/ nye ba'i ku shi dang*/ ku shi chen po/ rgyas byed dang*/ rgyas byed chen po dang*/ legs mthong dang*/ legs mthong chen po dang*/ gnod sel dang*/ nye ba'i gnod sel dang*/ rma bya dang*/ nges 'gro dang*/ bde byed dang*/ rab 'dul dang*/ rab tu sgra sgrags pa dang*/ rab tu dang ldan dang*/ 'od byed dang*/ lhun po dang*/ ri rab dang*/ lhun po ldan dang*/ me lce dang*/ me lce phreng dang*/ me lce ldan dang*/ me ldan gyi bu dang tsha bo dang yang tsha'i bu rgyud kyi rgyal po 'bum grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po dgra 'dul zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i bu tsha bo yang tsha'i brgyud kyi rgyal po lnga khri bzhi stong grong khyer 'thab med du byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po ma phebs pa 'bebs pa zhes bya ba bu tsha brgyud drug khri sum stong grong khyer wa ra ṇa sir byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po bzod dka' bu tsha brgyud brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer mda' 'dzin du byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po tshangs pas byin bu tsha brgyud sum khri ny-is stong grong khyer glang chen du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po glang po'i byin bu tsha brgyud lnga stong grong khyer rdo 'jog tu byung*/

de'i 'og tu rgyal po bal bu'i bu tsha brgyud sum khri nyis stong grong khyer lu ra shar du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po tshan chen thub kyi bu tsha brgyud sum khri nyis stong grong khyer ma phebs su byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po zhes bya ba bu tsha brgyud khri nyis stong grong khyer kan n+ya kub dzar byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po rgyal ba'i sde'u bu tsha brgyud khri brgyad stong grong khyer tsam pa kar byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po klu lha bu tsha brgyud nyis khṛ lnga stong grong khyer ta ma li ba ltar byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po mi'i lha bu tsha brgyud khri nyis stong grong khyer snga ma der byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po dug can pa'i lha bu tsha brgyud khri brgyad stong grong khyer so ldan du byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po blo bzang bu tsha brgyud chig khri nyis stong grong khyer rgyal po'i khab tu byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po mun sel bu tsha brgyud brgya tham pa grong khyer wā ra ṇa sir byung*/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po dbang chen sde bu tsha brgyud khri bzhi stong grong khyer ku shi ldan du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po rgya mtsho lha'i bu tsha brgyud stong grong khyer gru 'dzin du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po dka' thub spyod bu tsha brgyud brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer ku shi ldan du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po sa gtso bu tsha brgyud stong grong khyer wā ra ṇa sir byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po sa bdag bu tsha brgyud stong grong khyer 'thab med du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po sa 'dzin bu tsha brgyud brgyad khri stong grong khyer yang 'dres par byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po lha chen po bu tsha brgyud brgyad khri bzhi stong grong khyer 'dres par byung ngo*/ /de nas rgyal po des 'phan/ de'i bu mu khyud/ de bzhin du chig brgyud du mdzad nas mu khyud brtan/

tshan po che/ za ba/ nye za/ za ba can/ za ldan/ gya nom snang ba/ mnyam lta/ thos pa'i sde/ chos kyi sde/ rtogs pa/ rtogs chen/ rtogs sde/ mya ngan med/ mya ngan bral/ mtshams brtan/ rgan mtshamams/ dun du ma ra/ skya rengs/ phyogs bdag /rtul bzang*/ bde byed/ kun dga'/ me long zhal/ skyed pa po/ khyu chog /bza' btung ldan/ bza' btung mod/ thub med/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ brtan po/ rab brtan/ stobs po che/ bzhon pa mang*/ blo bzang*/ brtan gzhon/ gzhu bcu pa/ gzhu brgya pa/ gzhu dgu bcu pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i gzhu/ gzhu bkra/ gzhu sra/ gzhu brtan/ shing rta bcu pa/ shing rta brgya pa/ shing rta dgu bcu pa/ shing rta sna tshogs/ shing rta rnam pa sna tshogs/ shing rta gling pa/ shing rta brtan phyung ste de'i bu tsha brgyud bdun khri bdun stong grong khyer legs snang du byung*/ de'i rjes su rgyal po nam mkha'i bdag po dang*/ de'i bu klung bsrungs byung ste/ de'i bu tsha brgyud brgya thams pas grong khyer wā ra ṇa sir rgyal srid byas so/ /de'i rjes su tshe lo nyis khris dus su rgyal po kri ki zhes pa byung ste/ de'i tshe sangs rgyas 'od srung 'jig rten du byon no/ /rgyal po kri ki'i bu legs skyes bu tsha brgyud kyi rgyal po brgya tham pas grong khyer gru 'dzin du rgyal srid byas/ de'i rjes su rgyal po rna ba can byung*/ de'i bu ni go'u ta ma dang ba ra dha dza gnyis te go'u ta ma'i bu ni bu ram shing pa'o/ /bu ram shing pa'i bu tsha brgyud brgya tham pas kyang grong khyer gru 'dzin du rgyal srid byas so/ /de dag gi rjes su rgyal po 'phags skyes po zhes pa byung ste/ /'di la bu bzhi ste bzhin 'bar dang*/ lag rnams dang*/ glang chen 'dul dang*/ rkang gdub can no/ /rkang gdub can gyi bu ni gnas 'jig /de'i bu ba lang gnas/ de'i bu seng ge'i 'gram dang*/ sed+ge'i sgra'o/ /seṅge'i 'gram la bu bzhi ste/

zas gtsang dang*/ zas dkar dang*/ bre bo zas dang*/ bdud rtsi zas so/ /zas gtsang la bu gnyis te/ bcom ldan 'das dang*/ dga' bo'o/ /zas dkar gyi bu rgyal ba dang bzang ldan no/ /bre bo zas kyi bu ming chen dang ma 'gags pa'o/ /bdud rtsi'i zas kyi bu kun dga' bo dang*/ lhas byin no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi sras ni sgra gcan 'dzin no/ /de yan chad kyis bu ram shing ba'i rgyal brgyud rdzaugs kyang*/ mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal brgyud ni 'phags yul dang*/ bod du yang byon te rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po sogs so/ /mang bos bkur ba nas bzung ste ston pa'i bar rgyal rabs khyon bsdoms na/ dgu 'bum sum khri bdun stong lnga brgya dang so gcig byung ngo*/ /༈ gnyis pa la gnyis/ ston pa bzhugs dus su byon pa dang*/ ston pa 'das nas rgyal rabs sogs ji ltar byung tshul lo/ /dang po ni ston pa sku bltams pa dang dus mtshungs par rgyal po'i khab tu gzugs can snying po dang*/ kau sham+bhir nyi ma rab shar/ 'phags rgyal du gtum po rab snang*/ go sa lar rgyal po gsal rgyal rnams byung ngo*/ /de dag las rgyal po gzugs can snying po'i sras ni ma skyes dgra ste/ des bstan pa la bya ba byas tshul ni 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /yang de'i tshe u rgyan gyi yul du phyag rdor gyi sprul pa rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi chen po byon nas rgyun ring du bzhugs shing*/ ston pa'i bstan pa la gsang sngags kyi grub brnyes kun gyi thog ma yin/ gzhan yang*/ rgya gar gyi phyogs gzhan dag tu rgyal po che chung mang du byung yang bstan pa la bya ba chen po 'di byas mi snang bas ma bris so/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ rgyal rab dang bcas pa'i bstan 'dzin byon tshul dngos dang*/ thor bu phyogs gcig tu dgod pa dang*/ 'phros don no/ /dang po ni/ 'di dag gi byung tshul rgyas par bshad na po ti chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir don bsdus te bshad par bya'o/

/de la rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i ming gzhan rgyal po dge mthong zhes bya ste/ ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i phyi lo rgyal po 'dis sbyin bdag mdzad nas rgyal po'i khab tu kun dga'/ 'od srung*/ nye bar 'khor gsum gyis sde snod gsum bsdus te bka' bsdu dang po mdzad/ rgyal po 'di bsod nams 'phel te spong byed ma gtogs pa'i grong khyer chen po lnga po 'thab rtsod med par mnga' 'og tu chud do/ /ston pa dgung lo ngo mthong gya gcig bzhugs nas bstan pa 'od srung chen po la gtad/ des bstan pa bskyangs te lo 'ga' nas kun dga' bo la bstan pa gtad/ des khye'u gser mdog dgra bcom la bkod pa na/ ma skyes dgras kun dga' bo sogs dgra bcom pa lnga stong la lo lnga'i bar du yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas so/ /kun dga' bos ba ra dh+wa dza sogs la rdzu 'phrul dang chos bstan te bram ze lnga brgya dang skye bo khṛ khrag brgya bden pa mthong ba la bkod/ khyim bdag sha na'i gos can gyis kun dga' bo dang dge 'dun rnams la lo lngar dus ston chen po byas shing*/ kun dga' bos bskul te rab tu byung nas dgra bcom thob pa'i tshe bstan pa gtad/ kun dga' bos snga phyir dgra bcom la bkod pa ni khri skor byung ngo*/ /des ston pa 'das pa nas lo bzhi bcu'i skor bstan pa la bya ba khyad par can mang po mdzad nas mthar gad+ga'i chu dbus su nyi ma'i gung pa sogs rab tu byung nas mya ngan las 'das pa na/ sku gdung las me rang 'bar du byung nas bsregs te/ rin po'i che'i ga bur lta bu cha gnyis su song ba ma skyes dgra dang*/ spong byed pa rnams kyis blangs nas mchod par byas so/ /de'i phyi lo rgyal po ma skyes dgra yang 'das nas de'i bu lag bzang gis rgyal srid byas te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma'i gung ba 'khor dgra bcom pa khris bskor nas byang phyogs shi rang byon pa na der khyim bdag a dza zhes bya bas dge 'dun thams cad lo gcig gi bar mchod pa'i tshe dgra bcom pa bzhi khri 'dus so/

/sha na'i gos can gyis mnyan yod du chos bstan pas dgra bcom thob pa stong du nye ba byung ngo*/ /de nas lag bzang gi bu gzhung bzang gis rgyal srid byed pa'i tshe/ nyi ma'i gung pa kha cher byon te/ kha che'i skye bo mang po rdzu 'phrul gyis ri bo spos ngad ldan du khrid nas klu btul te gur gum mang po blangs nas slar kha cher phebs pa dang*/ kha che'i yul gur gum 'byung gnas su byin gyis brlabs so/ /yul de'i skye bo rnams la chos bstan nas don mang du mdzad/ sha na'i gos can gyis snga phyir chos bstan nas bden pa mthong ba ni 'bum tsam dang dgra bcom thob pa ni khri skor ro/ /'dis nyer spas la bstan pa gtad de yul tsam pa kar mya ngan las 'das so/ /de nas nyer sbas byang phyogs su gshegs te/ khyim bdag ba su ra zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas dge 'dun la mchod pa zhig yod pa der bzhugs nas chos bstan pas/ zla ba gsum la dgra bcom thob pa stong phrag gcig byung*/ ri'i rgyal po man+dha rar byon nas chos bstan pas skye bo dpag tu med pa bden pa mthong ba la bkod/ de nas yul bcom brlog tu byon nas bdud sdig can btul te nyin zhag bdun du chos bstan pas skye bo 'bum phrag bco brgyad bden pa mthong ba'i 'phags lam la bkod/ 'dis phug pa srid du khru bco brgyad dang rgyar khru bcu gnyis yod pa zhig tu/ dgra bcom thob par mdzad pa'i grangs kyi shing bu sor bzhi ba re 'phangs pas/ mthar phug pa de shing bu nges par mtshams med par gang ngo*/ /des na 'dis sangs rgyas dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i phrin las mdzad par grags so/ /mthar dhī ti ka la bstan pa gtad nas mya ngan las 'das pa na shing bu de rnams kyi sku gdung bsregs pa'i tshe gdung ril po ring bsrel gcig tu gyur ba lhas khyer ro/ /de'i tshe shar phyogs su dgra bcom pa bla ma zhes bya ba byung ste/ des rgyal po dbang chen dad par byas chos bstan pas 'bras bu bzhi thob par mang du byung zhing*/

de'i slob ma'i gtso bo dgra bcom pa grags pa'o/ /rgyal po tsa ma shas rgyal srid byed pa'i dus su yul ma ga dhar bram ze mo dza nas zhes bya ba la bu rgyal ba dang*/ legs rgyal dang*/ dge ba zhes bya ba gsum byung ste/ gsum kas kyang ston pa'i sku gzhugs pa'i lha khang re bzhengs nas mchod par byed cing*/ lha bzo rnams ni lha'i bzo bo mir sprul nas byas so/ /dge bas bzhengs pa'i lha khang dang rten rdo rje'i gdan gyi byang chub chen po lha khang rten dang bcas pa ste/ thub pa byang chub chen po 'di rang byon dngos su gsung 'byon mar yang grags shing*/ 'phags yul gyi rten kun gyi gtso bor gyur to/ /nyer sbas kyi dhī ti ka la bstan pa gtad pa na/ des grong khyer drug tu 'khor rnam bzhi la chos ston cing*/ bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ khyad par rgyal po mi na zhes bya ba 'khor bcas la chos bstan pas skye bo dpag tu med pa skyabs 'gro dang bslab pa'i gnas dang bden pa mthong ba la bkod cing*/ dgra bcom thob pa yang stong tsam byung*/ tshul de ltar yul gzhan dag tu byon nas rdzu 'phrul dang chos bstan nas skye bo khri khrag mang po smin grol gyi lam la bkod de bstan pa dar bar mdzad do/ /mthar dhī ti kas 'phags pa nag po la bstan pa gtad nas mya ngan las 'das so/ /de'i tshe byang phyogs su rgyal po mya ngan med ces pa byung ste/ des dmag byas te kha ba can dang li yul dang ri bo 'bigs byed kyi bar yul kun la dbang byas te sdig mang po bsags/ phyis dgra bcom pa grags pa dang mjal te chos bstan nas shin tu dad de dge 'dun khri la nyin re bzhin du mchod cing nyin mtshan du dge ba la 'bad do/ /de nas dgra bcom pa des sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pa'i tshul bshad pas/ de'i tshai ma skyes dgra'i gdung skal gyi ring bsrel sngon ma ga dha'i bre bo che gang rgyal po'i khab kyi mchod rten gyi 'og gter du sbas yod pa phyis khal drug gi tshad du 'phel ba las rgyal pos khro bo che gcig blangs nas nyin bzhag gcig la ring bsrail snying po can gyi mchod rten brgyad khri stong grub par byas/

'ga' zhig las 'bum grub par yang bshad do/ /yul thams cad la bka' bsgos te mchod rten rnams la rin po che dang gdugs mar me bdug spos sogs mchod pa'i rnam grangs du mas mchod par byas/ skye 'phags kyi dge 'dun stong phrag mang po la zla ba drug gi bar du mchod cing*/ mthar dge slong re re la gos rin thang shin tu che ba re re phul nas 'tshang rgya ba'i smon lam btab pa 'grub pa'i rtags byung*/ phyis dge 'dun 'bum phrag du ma la lo lnga'i bar dus ston chen po byas/ dus gzhan zhig na yang dge 'dun dpag tu med pa re re la gser srang du ma dang yo byad gzhan mang du phul/ mdor na rgyal po 'di ni stobs 'byor dang dge 'dun gyi zhabs tog byas pa 'dra ba 'phags yul gyi rgyal po sul 'ang ma byung snyam/ rgyal po 'di la dang po gtum po mya ngan med/ bar du 'dod chen mya ngan med/ phyis chos rgyal mya ngan med du grags te don dang mthun no/ /dhī ti ka'i sku tshe'i smad du ko'u sham+bher dge slong rnams la chos ston cing bzhugs pa'i skabs zhig yangs pa can gyi dge slong dag gis mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu la spyod pa ni/ rgyal po 'dis sbyin bdag byas nas dgra bcom pa grags pa sogs kyis bka' bsdu gnyis pa mdzad/ 'di ston pa 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu skor song ba na byung bar mngon no/ /de'i tshe 'phags pa nag po pas bstan pa bskyangs shing chos bstan nas 'bras bu bzhi thob pa shin tu mang ba byung*/ sing ga lar byon nas chos bstan nas mang po zhig 'bras bu bzhi la bkod de/ gling der bstan pa dar bar mdzad do/ /mthar 'phags pa legs mthong la bstan pa gtad nas mya ngan las 'das/ legs mthong gis sngar bzhin bstan pa'i rgyun bskyangs shing lho phyogs kyi rgyud du byon nas lha khang bzhengs pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyis khyab par byas/ gling phran mang por yang bstan pa'i srol btsugs te mi ma yin mang po btul/

sems can dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod de mya ngan las 'das so/ /mdor na 'od srung chen po/ /kun dga' bo/ /sha na'i gos can/ nyer sbas/ dhi ti ka/ nag po pa/ legs mthong chen po ste bdun ni bstan pa'i gtan rabs so/ /de bdun gyis ston pa 'das nas bstan pa la bya ba chen po byas la/ ston pa bzhugs pa'i dus su ni snga ma gnyis dang shā ri'i bus bstan pa la bya ba chen po mdzad do/ /mya ngan med sku gshegs nas de'i rgyal srid la bu mya ngan bral bskos/ de'i dus su dgra bcom pa 'od srung zhes bya ba byung ste bstan pa dang sems can du ma la phan btags/ mya ngan bral gyi bu'i btsun mo lha mo dpal grub pa zhig gis phyogs bzhi'i dge slong rnams mchod cing*/ lo gsum du sngar gyi sa steng gi mchod rten thams cad la mchod pa'i rnam grangs mang po byas/ bcom brlag tu bram ze grags ldan zhes bya bas lha khang bzhengs nas dge 'dun 'bum phrag la dus ston chen po btsugs/ rgyal po dga' bo zhes bya ba'i dus su bram ze mkhas pa zhes bya ba byung ste/ phyogs bzhi'i dge slong rnams bsdus te lo bdun du mchod pa byas/ de'i rjes su ka shi wa ṇa sir zhes pa'i rgyal pos lo mang du dge slong rnams la mchod/ 'di'i dus su dge slong klu zhes bya ba byung nas chos ston tshul gyi dbang gis sde pa bzhir gyes so/ /de'i tshe bram ze pā ྄ṇis 'phags pa 'jig rten 'jig rten dbang phyug bsgrubs te zhal gzigs nas sgra rig pa ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po pā ṇi brtsams/ de nas rgyal po mes byin zhes bya bas dgra bcom pa chos kyi tshong dpon sogs 'phags pa sum stong la lo sum cu lhag tsam du mchod/ gnas brtan klu'i rjes 'jug dge slong zhig gis rtsod pa spel bas sde ba bco brgyad du gyes pa'i 'go brtsams/ rgyal po pad+ma chen po'i grogs po bram ze bzang po dang*/

mchog srid gnyis byung ba'i gnyis kas dge 'dun la mchod pa chen po byas/ rgyal pos kyang gtsug lag khang nyi shu bzhengs nas mchod/ yul o bi shir rgyal po zla ba srung zhes bya ba byung ste/ de'i khyim du 'phags pa 'jam dpal dge slong gi gzugs byon nas theg pa chen po chos ci rigs bstan cing*/ khyim du sher phyin gyi glegs bam zhig bzhag ste/ ston pa 'das nas mi yul du theg pa chen po'i chos byung ba'i thog ma'o/ /de'i rjes su rgyal rigs legs mthong zhes bya ba'i dgra bcom pas dza lan+dha ri'i rgyal po zhig dad pa la bkod nas des byang phyogs kyi mchod rten thams cad mchod cing phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la dus ston mang du btsugs/ dge slong yang dag rgyal ba can zhes bya bas dge 'dun 'bum phrag gnyis kyi zhabs tog mdzad/ kha che'i bram ze'i su rta zhes bya bas bye smra'i btsun pa chos skyob sogs dge slong lnga stong la mchod de/ sde snod gsum lhag par dar bar byas/ de'i tshe shar phyogs nas 'phags pa rtsibs logs zhes bya ba dgra bcom pa zhig gis/ rgyal po kri ki'i rmi lam du lung bstan te sde pa bco brgyad po thams cad bstan pa rnam dag tu bsgrubs nas bka' bsdu gsum pa byas/ 'di'i dus su sde snod gsum po yi ger bkod cing*/ sngar re gnyis 'khod pa la'ang dag ther byas so/ /de'i rjes su byang phyogs su khyim bdag dza ṭi zhes bya bas byang phyogs kyi mchod rten rnams la mchod cing*/ bye brag smra ba'i btsun pa dbyig bshes dang*/ dbyangs sgrogs gnyis spyan drangs nas/ dge slong sum 'bum la lo bcu gnyis su mchod de byang chub smon lam btab pa 'grub pa'i ltas byung*/ rgyal po ka ni ka'i bus dgra bcom pa brgyad dang dge slong gzhan khri la lo lngar dus ston byas/ bram ze ba duḥzhes bya bas sho lo 'bum re yod pa'i sde snod gsum tshar brgya phrag mang po bzhengs te mchod/

'phags pa a shwa gu ba ta zhes bya bas chos bstan pas dgra bcom pa dang 'phags pa slob pa mang du byung*/ lak+sha a shwa zhes bya ba'i rgyal pos kyang bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher byas/ lho nub tu bram ze rigs ldan zhes bya ba byung ste/ des dgra bcom pa nan+d+ta sogs theg chen ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po spyan drangs te/ de rnams kyang rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ byams pa sogs so so la chos dngos su gsan nus pa'o/ /mdor na de'i tshe theg pa chen po'i chos ston pa po lnga brgya tsam byung ngo*/ /de'i tshe sher phyin 'bum pa ma gtogs theg chen gyi mdo phal cher byung ste/ lha klu sogs kyi yul nas kyang spyan drangs so/ /de'i dus su rgyal po lak+sha a shwas chos smra ba de dag lnga brgya'i grangs kyi lha khang de snyed bzhengs nas chos smra ba de rnams spyan drangs nas bzhugs par mdzad de/ /blo rno ba lnga brgya rab tu byung nas theg pa chen po'i chos nyan tu bcug /rgyal pos sde snod 'bum phrag bzhugs pa rnams bris nas dge slong rnams la phul te phyis nā lan+dar spyan drangs nas bzhugs/ chos smra ba'i dge slong lnga brgya po thams cad kyang gzugs dang bzod pa thob pa/ mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa sha stag go /de'i tshe nyan thos sde pa dag gis blor ma shong nas theg pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi chos bka' ma yin no zhes skur ba btab/ de'i skabs su ma ga dhar bram ze tho btsun grub rje dang*/ bde byed bdag po zhes bya ba byung ste/ tho btsun gyis ston pa la khyad par 'phags stod dang*/ bde byed kyi lha las phul byung gi bstod pa brtsams te kun la spel zhing*/ snga mas theg pa che chung gi dge slong lnga brgya re la 'tsho ba sbyar/ de gnyis kas gtsug lag khang brgyad bzhengs nas theg chen gyi glegs bam rnams bzhugs par byas/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po tsan dan skyong gi lha khang bzhengs nas dge 'dun gyi sde la mchod/

de nas sa ra hāṃ bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po yang nā lan+da rar byon te/ gsang sngags kyi slob dpon 'ga' dang*/ gsang ba'i bdag po sogs lhag pa'i lha la mdo sngags thams cad gsan cing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas kyang rjes su bzung ste grub pa brnyes shing*/ dbu ma'i lugs dar bar mdzad do/ /'di dang dus mnyam du ka ma la gar+bha sogs dbu ma'i tshul ston pa'i slob dpon brgyad byung*/ de'i tshe sgrib sel gyis rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon zhig gis 'dus pa chen po'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'bum yod pa spyan drangs/ sngar gyi slob dpon lnga brgya'i slob ma mang pos rgyud sde bzhi ci rigs spyan drangs/ gzhan yang dge slong brtson 'grus chen po dang*/ sangs rgyas lha dang*/dpal len rnams kyis nyan thos kyi theg pa dar bar byas shing*/ chos skyong dang*/ dbyangs sgrogs dang*/ dbyig bshes dang*/ sangs rgyas lha bzhi slob ma dang bcas pas kyang bye smra ba'i lugs dar bar mdzad/ dus 'di tsam nas rgyal po bi su kalba zhes pa byung ste 'dus pa bstan/ bram ze chos ldan zhes bya bas kyang lha khang brgya rtsa dang*/ 'dul ba ston pa'i chos gzhi brgya rtsa brgyad byas/ de'i dus su rgyal po ha ra tsan+d+ras sngags lam la brten nas rig 'dzin thob bo/ /de'i rjes su 'phags pa klu sgrub byon te/ dpal sa ra ha'i bram ze sgra can 'dzin dpal bzang po las mdo sngags kyi chos gsan nas dbu ma'i tshul dar bar mdzad/ nyan thos pa rnams la'ang phan cher btags/ tshul khrims 'chal ba dge 'dun gyi nang na dbang chen por 'dug pa mang po gnas nas bskrad/ nā lan+d+ra'i mkhan po dang sde pa kun gyi bdag po mdzad cing*/ nā lan+da rar theg pa chen po'i chos smra ba po lnga brgya la lo mang po'i bar du gser 'gyur gyi rtsi'i sbyor ba la brten nas 'tsho ba sbyar/ lha mo tsan+ṭi ka bsgrubs nas dge 'dun la 'tsho ba sbyor bar mdzad pa na/

dge tshul ngan pa zhig gis lha mo de la 'dod pa'i dus btab pa'i rkyen gyis lha mo de mi snang bar song bas lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs nas chos gzhi gtsugs/ der nag po chen po'i sku re re bzhengs nas bstan pa srung ba'i gnyer gtad byas/ rdo rje'i gdan gyi byang chub kyi shing la glang chen gyi gnod pa srung ba'i thabs su nag po chen po sku dang mchod rten brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten la lcags ris bskor zhing*/ nang du mchod khang mang po bzhengs/ klu yul nas sher phyin 'bum pa spyan drangs/ rigs tshogs drug la sogs pa dbu ma ston pa'i bstan bcos dang*/ gsang 'dus kyi skor 'ga' zhig mdzad/ sgrol ma dang 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi ngo bo rgyal sras blo gros rin chen gyis zhal gzigs te rjes su bzung*/ /rgyal po bde spyod btul nas des gtsug lag khang mang du bzhengs/ brag ri 'ga' zhig gser du bsgyur bar bzhed pa na sgrol mas ma 'ongs na rtsod pa'i gzhir 'gyur gsungs nas bkag /bram ze ma dhu dang*/ pra ma dhu gnyis btul nas de gnyis kyis theg chen gyi chos smra ba po nyis brgya lnga bcu re mchod cing*/ theg chen gyi gsung rab rnams bris/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba brgya phrag mang po yang rtsod pas tshar bcad nas bstan pa la bcug ste bstan pa sgo thams cad nas rgyas par mdzad/ dpal gyi ri la sgrub pa mdzad pas sku tshe de la grub pa mchog brnyes te/ sku gser gyi mdog can la mtshan dpes brgyan par gyur/ ston pa 'das nas lo bzhi brgya'i dus su 'byon pa dang*/ lo drug brgyar bzhugs par lung bstan kyang bar du bde ba can du byon/ khyad par du chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis med cing tha snyad du yod pa'i dbu ma'i srol legs par phye'o/ /de'i tshe btsun pa dga' bo dang*/ dam pa'i sde dang*/ yang dag bden pa gsum gyis sems tsam pa'i lugs ston pa'i bstan bcos ci rigs mdzad/

de tsam nas rgyal po muñtsa 'khor mang po dang bcas pas rig 'dzin grub cing*/ rgyal po bhe dza 'khor stong dang cas pas kyang mi snang ba sogs kyi grub pa brnyes/ de'i dus su bram ze biṣ+ṇu zhes bya bas nā lan+dar lha khang dang lha mang po bzhengs nas/ theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi de snyed btsugs/ klu sgrub kyi grogs po slob dpon mchog srid kyis spyan ras gzigs lo bcu gnyis su bsgrubs pas zhal gzigs te grub pa chen po brgyad grub cing de'i sgo nas mang po la phan btags/ skabs 'dir sgra'i bstan bcos kā la pa byung ste/ lo rgyus la mi mthun pa snang ngo*/ /dgra bcom pa dge 'dun 'phel yang dus 'dir byung*/ rgyal po ha ri bha dra 'khor stong dang bcas pas ri lu'i dngos grub thob/ dus de tsam nas kla klo'i chos dang por byung ste/ de yang sde snod 'dzin pa mang du thos pa zhig bslab pa 'chal bas dge 'dun gyi gnas dbyung byas pa na/ des gzhan du song nas 'tshe ba chos su smar ba'i bstan bcos brtsams shing*/ bdud kyis byin gyis brlabs pas rigs sngags kyang mang po 'grub/ bstan bcos de gter du sbas pa na bdud kyis sprul pa zhig byung ste bton nas gzhan la bstan pas dar ro/ /de'i rjes rgyal po ni ma tsan+t+ra'i dus su mu stegs rnams 'dus nas dmag byas te nang pa'i gtsug lag khang mang po mer bsregs/ dge slong mang po yang bsad/ 'ga' zhig yul gzhan du bros pas bstan pa cung zad 'grib par byas/ de'i rjes su rgyal go ḍe 'phel/ ces bya bas sngar gyi gtsug lag nyams pa rnams bsos te chos gzhi rgyas par byas/ gnas brtan pas ma rdzogs zhes pas kyang nyan thos kyi sde snod rgyas par byas shing*/ ma ga dhār chos gzhi drug cu btsugs/ de'i tshe kla klo'i rgyal po'i thog ma rgyal po ha lu zhes pa byung*/ bram ze shi dza ta zhes pas sngar gyi chos gzhi kun mchod cing*/

chos smra ba drug cu rtsa bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'tsho ba sbyar nas bstan pa nyams pa bsos/ de'i tshe nā lan+tar slob dpon ār+ya de ba dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub sogs kyis bstan pa bskyangs/ slob dpon ār+ya de bas gtso bor mgon po klu sgrub bsten nas mdo sngags thams cad thugs su chud de yang slob dpon klu sgrub rgyal pau bde spyod kyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i tshe mjal nas/ phyis dpal gyi rir dpon slob gnyis kas sgrub pa mdzad pas skabs zhig na/ lha dbang phyug chen pos dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i mu stegs rta dbyangs zhes bya bas rgya gar shar phyogs pa'i sangs rgyas pa rnams rtsod pas pham par byas te/ yul dbus nā len+d+rar 'ongs nas rtsod pa bya'o zhes brjod pa'i tshe/ der bzhugs pa'i gnas brtan rgan pa dag gis 'dis bstan pa nyams par byed par sangs rgyas kyis lung bstan pas rang re rnams kyis mi thub kyi/ klu sgrub yab sras dpal gyi rir bzhugs pa spyan drangs nas rtsod pa byed du gzhug go zhes brjod pa ltar/ chos skyong la bskul nas springs yig bskur ba slob dpon yab sras la 'phrod pas/ 'dul ba'i dus yin par mkhyen nas ār+ya de ba btang bas byon/ dbang phyug gis gnang ba'i sring mo paṇ+d+ri ta dang*/ ne tso dang*/ thod lo dang kor rnams dge brnyen/ byi la/ mar nag gsum gyis btul nas mu stegs dang brtsad pas slob dpon rgyal te mu stegs rta dbyangs nang bar bcug /'dis ni dgos pa'i dbang gis mu stegs kyi tshul bstan pa tsam du sems te/ 'di sangs rgyas kyis lan gnyis lung bstan pa mthong ba'i phyir ro/ /rab tu byung nas slob dpon rta dbyangs zhes phyi nang gnyis ka'i grub mtha' kun la mkhas pa'i dbang por 'gyur/ de'i rkyen gyis mu stegs pa mang po zhig kyang nang bar zhugs/ ār+ya de bas bzhi brgya pa sogs btsams te klu sgrub lugs kyi dbu ma'i srol bzung*/

nā lan+t+ra dang lho phyogs kyi rgyud du sems can mang po'i don mdzad de/ mthar sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya ba zhig la bstan pa gtad nas 'das/ rta dbyangs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa dang skye rabs brtsams pa sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa la phan btags pa dus der slob dpon klu sgrub zhes bya ba klu rnams kyis spyan drangs te/ klu rnams la phan btags cing theg pa chen po'i mdo sde du ma'i bshad par mdzad do/ /klu sgrub 'phags pa lha rta dbyangs klu bos rnams ni sangs rgyas kyis 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du lung bstan pas gang zag khyad par can kho na'o/ /slob dpon klu byang ni klu sgrub kyi phyag g.yog nyer gnas te/ bcud len gyi dngos grub thob cing*/ gsang 'dus gyi dkyil mchog nyi shu pa brtsams/ phyis dngos grub mchog brnyes nas de lta yang dpal gyi rir bzhugs par grags/ klu sgrub kyi slob ma grub thob shing kha ba ni/ phyag chen gyi dngos grub thob pa zhig ste/ lan gcig snod chus gang ba mang por rang gi dri chu cung zad re blugs pa tsam gyis chu thams cad gser 'gyur gyi rtsir bsgyur ro/ /slob dpon gyis de dag gter du sbas te ma 'ongs par na phan pa'i smon lam btab*/ shākya bshes gnyen ni slob dpon n+yaṃ slob ma gsang 'dus ky-i brgyud 'dzin zhig yin la/ shā wa ri dbang phyug ni bde mchog dang mgon po'i bla brgyud nas 'byung ba bzhin te grub pa brnyes pa'o/ /grub thob ma tang ki ni gsang 'dus kyi brgyud 'dzin snga ma las cung zad phyi'o/ /de nas rgyal po snying po theg le'i slob dpon bram ze tsan ka zhes bya ba byung ste/ des gshin rje gshed grub cing rgyal po dang bcas pas drag po'i las sbyor gyis rgyal po gzhan gyi 'bangs las skye bo stong phrag mang po smyo ba dang*/ bskrad pa dang*/ dbye ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ lkugs par byas pas shi nas dmyal bar skyes pa/

gshin rje gshed kyis drangs par bshad de/ des na gzhan la gnod che ba'i drag las byas na lha dngos su 'grub kyang ngan song du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rta dbyangs sam ma khol gyi sku tshe'i smad la rgyal po shrī tsan+t+ras spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig bzhengs te/ theg chen gyi chos smra ba nyis stong re'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ 'phags pa lha'i slob ma sgra gcan 'dzin gyis nā lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad de/ dri gtsang khang bcu bzhi bzhengs nas chos gzhi mi 'dra ba bcu bzhi btsugs/ rgyal po ka ni kas gtsug lag khang chen po bzhi bzhengs te/ chos smra ba sum khri re la rgyun du mchod/ de nas rgyal po dhārmā tsan+t+ra dang de'i slob dpon ba su ne tras kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan chen po btags/ de'i tshe bram ze tu ru ṣ+ka'i rgyal po zhig gis dmag byas nas ma ga dha'i gtsug lag khang mang po bshig /nā lan+dar gnod pa chen po byas pas dge 'dun rnams thag ring por bros/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs zhes bya bas rgyal phran mang po dang 'dus te/ stag gzig gi rgyal po la dmag byas te bsad nas sngar bshig pa'i lha khang thams cad bsos/ dge 'dun rnams spyan drangs nas nā lan+dar chos gzhi brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byas te bstan pa slar rgyas par byas so/ /de nas slob dpon mā li ka bud+dhi zhes bya bas chos gzhi nyer gcig btsugs shing/ mchod rten lha can stong bzhengs te sher phyin gyi chos dar bar byas so/ /slob dpon kun tu bzang po zhes bya ba mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob cing*/ des sngar gyi mchod rten bshig pa rnams bsos te/ re re la mchod rten bcu bcus bskor/ gzhan gyis phrag dog byas pa na 'phags pa kun tu bzang pos khrid de li yul du phyin nas bstan pa dar bar byas/ de'i tshe rgyal po'i blon po zhig gis lha khang bzhengs pa'i dga' ston gyi dus su dge 'dun tshogs pa'i tshe/

dge tshul gtum po zhig gis mu stegs slong mo ba gnyis la khrus khu gtor/ sgo glegs kyi bar du btsir khyi rbad pas de gnyis shin tu khros nas gcig gis nyi ma bsgrubs pas 'grub ste/ sngags bzlas pa'i thal ba gtor ba tsam gyis me 'bar du byung nas sangs rgyas pa'i chos gzhi brten pa'i lha khang brgyad cu rtsa bzhi mer bsreg / gsur rab mtha' dag bzhugs pa'i lha khang gsum yang bsreg nas yul gzhan du bros kyang*/ sdig pa'i las kyis rang lus la me 'bar nas shi/ de nas phyogs phyogs kyi dge slong rnams kyi blo la bzhugs pa dang*/ glegs bam du bzhugs pa thor pa rnams bsdus te yi ger spel/ rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhen che bas/ des sngar lha khang mes tshig pa rnams slar bsos so/ /de yang sngon mi yul du sde snod cha bco lnga tsam byung ba'i cha bcu bzhi'i tshad me dgra sogs kyi rkyen dbang gis nub nas da lta cha gcig tsam lus gsung ngo*/ /de nas rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs kyis gtsug khang chen po zhig bzhengs nas bka' dang bstan bcos mtha' dag bsdus nas tshar gsum bzhengs/ chos gzhi chen po brgya dang dge slong lnga brgya tshogs par byas/ yang rgyal po de'i blon po rnams kyis lha khang zhig bzhengs/ der bram ze shaṅku gsung rab rnams bzhengs nas/ bram ze phur bus kyang lha khang bzhengs te chos gzhi dang dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba rnams sbyar ro/ /bram ze shaṅku sgrol mas rjes su bzung bas sgrol ma'i lha khang zhig kyang bzhengs te/ dkon mchog la mchod pa chen po byas so/ /bram ze 'di gnyis kas kyang klu dbang du sdud nus shing*/ phyi mas ku ru ku le'i rig sngags grub bo/ de'i 'og tu rgyal po sangs rgyas phyogs kyi bu zab mo'i phyogs zhes bya ba byung ste/ dge 'dun mang po bsdus nas mchod cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi tshems bzhugs pa'i mchod rten chen po zhig bzhengs/

dge slong sogs brgya phrag mang po mchod rten mchod par bskos/ sku gzugs kyang shin tu mang po bzhengs/ de'i tshe dge slong dzi ba ka ra dang*/ dge bsnyen chos 'phel zhes bya ba rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa 'khor lnga stong res bskor ba sher phyin gyi don nyams su len pa byung*/ dus der slob dpon arta zhes bya ba bum pa bzang po grub pa zhig byung ste/ des dge 'dun mang po la lo bzhi bcur nye bar mchod pa byas/ 'di mthu shin tu che ste tshangs pa dbang phyug brgya byin yang rig sngags kyis 'gug nus so/ /grub chen lū hi ba yang skabs 'dir byon par gsal zhing lo rgyus gzhan du blta'o/ /'phags pa thogs med kyis slob dpon arta la byams pa'i sgrub thabs zhus nas lo bcu gnyis su bsgoms pas zhal dngos su gzigs/ dga' ldan du 'khrid nas chos bstan te byams chos sde lnga gnang*/ slar 'dzam gling du byon nas theg pa chen po'i chos dar bar byas/ sa sde lnga sogs bstan bcos mang du brtsams te sems tsam pa'i shing rta'i srol phye/ rdzu 'phrul dang gzhan sems shes pa'i mngon shes thog med mnga'/ dgung lo mang du lon kyang sngon byams pas zhal gzigs pa'i dus kyi na tshod ltar gnas/ shin tu zhi zhing dul yang grub mtha' ngan pa dang spyod pa ngan pa tshar gcod pa sogs la lhag par rno/ ting 'dzin mtha' yas pa thob cing*/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu phyin/ gdul bya grangs med pa yang dag pa'i lam la bkod/ rgyal po zab mo'i phyogs kyis slob dpon 'di la mngon shes yod pa bden mi bden brtags pas bden par shes te dga' nas dad pa na/ slob dpon gyis bskul te theg chen gyi chos gzhi nyer lnga byed du bcug /slob dpon lho phyogs su bram ze ba su nā ga zhes bya bas gdan drangs pas 'khor bcas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon te de'i yul gyi skye bo rnams la chos mang du bstan/ u rgyan gyi yul du de bzhin du byon nas ring bar bzhugs/

yul de gnyis kar theg chen dar bar mdzad de/ mchod rten brgya phrag re dang*/ lha khang nyi shu tsa lnga re bzhengs/ theg chen gyi chos gzhi re yang btsugs/ ma ga dhar yang mchod rten brgya dang chos gzhi nyer lnga btsugs/ slob dpon 'di la mngon shes thogs med mnga' ba'i stobs kyis chos bstan pa la don du ma gyur pa gcig kyang med do/ /slob dpon rang nyid kyis chos gzhi brgya dang*/ re rer yang blo sbyong ba nyis brgya re nyung mtha' byung*/ spyir chos nyan pa dpag tu med pa las sa thob pa dang lam rgyud la skyes pa stong phrag mang po byung*/ grub mtha'i sgo thams cad gsungs pas nyan thos rnams kyang lhag pa dad/ klu sgrub kyi dus las kyang 'di dus theg chen gyi dge slong mang ste/ khri khrag mang po byung zhes grags/ slob ma grangs med kyang lhan cig gnas pa nyer lnga tsam ste/ thams cad kyang tshul khrims dag pa/ sde snod 'dzin pa/ bzod pa thob pa/ lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung ba sha stag go /sku tshe'i smad la nā lan+dar bzhugs pa'i tshe dgun dus nyin re bzhin mu stegs kyi rgol ba re yong ba la/ de'i grub mtha' rigs pa sna tshogs kyis sun phyung mu stegs stong tsam nang bar btsug /dge slong lta ba dang tshul khrims nyams pa sogs tshar bcad nas 'khor rnams kyang shin tu dag par mdzad de/ mthar rgyal po'i khab tu sku gshegs so/ gcung dbyeg gnyen ni/ kha cig thogs med kyi mtshe ma'i sku mched dang*/ 'ga' zhig thogs med 'khrungs pa'i phyi lo 'khrungs zhes zer zhing gang ltar yang yum cig go /rab tu byung nas kha che'i slob dpon 'dun bzang sogs bsten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs gnas dang sde snod gsum las mkhas par byas/ 'phags pa thogs med las theg chen gyi sde snod ma lus par gsang bas thugs su chud cing*/ der ma zad rgyal ba'i bka' mi yul na bzhugs pa thams cad kyi tshig don mkhyen pas/

ston pa 'das nas slob dpon dbyig gnyen lta bu'i mang du thos pa ni 'ga' yang med do sngags shing sangs rgyas gnyis pa grags/ theg chen gyi mdo gzungs mang po dang*/ brgyad stong pa nyin re bzhin tshar re gsungs/ thogs med kyis nā lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad rjes su slob dpon 'dis mdzad/ rab tu 'byung ba dang chos spyod bcu nyin re bzhin mdzad/ nyin re bzhin theg chen gyi mdo sde mi 'dra ba'i chos thun lan mang du gsung*/ bar bar du bstan bcos rtsom pa dang*/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po bzlog par mdzad/ mdo sde du ma'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mdzad cing*/ sa sde lnga sogs ni grags che'o/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi gzungs 'bum bzlas pa de'i rigs sngags 'grub cing*/ gsang bdag gi zhal mngon gsum sum du gzigs te chos gsan/ ting nge 'dzin dpag tu med pa thob/ ma ga dhar chos gzhi rnyed pa gso ba dang*/ theg chen gyi chos gzhi gsar pa brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs/ shar phyogs gau ri'i yul du byon nas chos bstan pas lhas me tog gi char mang po dngos su 'bab pa de'i skye bo kun gyis blangs/ chos gzhi yang brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs/ o ḍir shar bram ze zhig gi bos nas byon te mang po la chos bstan pas de'i khyim du rin po che'i 'byung khungs brdol der chos bzhi brgya rtsa brgyad btsugs slob dpon gyi phyogs gzhan dang gzhan du rgyal po sogs la bka' bsgos pas btsugs pa kun bsdoms na/ chos gzhi drug brgya lnga bcu byung ngo*/ /zhes grags/ thogs med kyi dus las kyang 'di dus theg chen dar che ste/ theg chen gyi dge slong kun bsdoms na drug khri longs skad/ slob dpon nyid dang lhan cig gnas pa'i dge slong yang stong tsam ste/ thams cad kyang tshul khrims ldan zhing mang du thos pa sha stag go /slob dpon 'di gang du bzhugs pa der rin po che'i 'byung khungs brdol ba dang*/

mi ma yin gyis yo byad sbyor ba sogs mang ngo*/ bsams na shes pa'i mngon shes mnga' bas dris pa thams cad bden par lus ston nus shing*/ bden stobs brjod pas grong khyer me shor ba zhi ba dang*/ rims nad zhi bar byed nus/ snga phyir mu stegs kyi rgol ba lnga brgya rigs pas sun phyung zhing*/ spyir bram ze dang mu stegs stong phrag lnga tsam bstan pa la bcug /mthar slob ma dang bcas pa la yul du phyin nas chos gzhi btsugs te dge 'dun gyi sde mang po spel/ der khyim btsun zhig chos gos gyon bzhin du zhing rmo bar gzigs nas bstan pa nyams so/ /zhes gsungs te/ dge 'dun rnams la chos bstan nas mya ngan las 'das pas chos kyi nyi ma re zhig nub ces grags so/ /slob dpon 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po tho ri gnyan gtsan byung ba dus mnyam par grags/ slob dpon 'di dgung lo brgyar nye ba tsam bzhugs/ thogs med lo brgya dang lnga bcur bzhugs ces lung bstan pa ni phyed lo yin zhes gsungs te zhib cha dgos par snang ngo*/ /dbyig gnyen gyi sku tshe'i stod du rgyal po dā ri ka pa dang smad la slob dpon blo brtan dang*/ yon tan 'od dang*/ phyogs glang dang*/ de'i cung zad rjes su slob dpon 'phags pa grol sde byon/ de las cung zad phyi tsam nas sangs rgyas bskyangs dang de'i 'og tu legs ldan dang*/ de nas btsun pa grol sde byung*/ 'di dus zla ba grags pa yang byon/ legs ldan gyi dus tsam nas rgyal po shri hāng+sha zhes bya ba stobs can zhig byung ste/ des kla klos bstan pa bsnubs par 'dod nas dben par zhig tu shing 'ba' zhig las byas pa'i khang pa chen po brtsigs nas der kla klo'i ston pa 'khor bcas bos te zla ba 'gar zhabs tog byas/ de'i lugs kyi chos rnams bsdus nas lhan cig thams cad mer bsregs pas kla klo'i lugs 'dzin pa stong phrag bcu gnyis tsam 'tshig /de'i sdig pa sbyong ba'i ched du yul mang por gtsug lag khang re bzhengs nas dge 'dun stong phrag re'i 'tsho ba sbyar te chos shin tu dar ba byas so/

/slob dpon blo brtan ni sgrol mas byin gyi brlabs pas blo gros thogs med du gyur te/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po tshar bcad pas smra ba'i dbang phyug tu grags/ mngon pa la shin tu mkhas shing slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyi gzhung la 'grel pa dga' re mdzad/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa zhal 'don mdzad cing*/ bya ba thams cad sgrol mas ston/ chos gzhi brgya rtsa btsugs/ slob dpon yon tan 'od ni/ slob dpon dbyig gnyen brten nas gzhung lugs spyi dang*/ 'dul ba la mkhas shing*/ 'dul ba 'bum sde la zhal 'don mdzad/ tshul khrims shin tu dag pas bden tshig brjod pa 'grub/ gdul ba'i gzhung gi tshig don mtha' dag sdud pa'i mdo rtsa ba brtsams pa sogs kyis bstan pa rgyas par byas so/ /phyogs glang ni phyi nang gi grub mtha' kun la mkhas shing*/ dbyig gnyen bsten te tshad ma la lhag par mkhas/ 'jam dbyangs kyis dngos su byin gyis brlabs pas tshad ma rig pa ston pa'i bstan bcos thor bu mang du mdzad/ tshad ma kun btus mdzad par bzhed pa'i tshe mchod brjod bris pa mu stegs nag po zhes bya bas lkog tu bsubs pas/ slob dpon gyis rtsod par nus na lus ston cig ces bris pa'i tshe des lus bstan te slob dpon dang brtsad pan slob dpon gyis de lan gsum du pham par mdzad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus ni gzhan du gsal/ de nas kun btus kyang brtsams/ mu stegs kyi rgol ba du ma dang khyad par du gzhan gyis thub dka' ba dag kyang rigs pas tshar bcad te bstan pa la bcug pas rtsod pa'i khyu mchog tu grags/ chos gzhi nyams pa mang po bsos/ chos kyi slob mas phyogs kun tu khyab kyang lhan cig gnas pa gcig kyang ma bzung*/ 'dis rgyal po'i slob dpon zhig bskul nas lha khang bcu drug bzhengs su bcug ste de re rer dge 'dun gyi sde dang chos gzhi mang du yod par byas so/ /'phags pa grol sde ni/

slob dpon dbyig gnyen bsten nas sher phyin la mkhas par sbyangs shing*/ slob dpon dge 'dun srung ba'i slob ma mdzad nas sher phyin gyi man ngag mtha' dag zhus/ de gnyis kyi sku tshe'i smad kyi slob ma'o/ /yum gsum gyi don thams cad thugs su chud nas yum don dbu mar 'grel ba la/ nyi khri'i 'grel ba nye snang brtsams pa ni grags che/ sher phyin gtso bor bshad pas lo sum cu'i bar du dge slong sher phyin nyan mkhan stong re 'dus/ slob dpon dge 'dun 'bangs ni/ mngon pa la mkhas shing mngon pa'i chos gzhi nyer bzhi btsugs/ gtsug lag khang gnyis bzhengs nas theg chen yang dar bar byas/ chos 'bangs ni sde snod gsum la mkhas shing*/ phyogs bzhir 'jam dbyangs kyi lha khang re re bzhengs/ 'di gnyis ka'ang dbyig gnyen gyi slob ma'o/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs kyis dge 'dun srung las klu sgrub kyi gzhung rnams gsan nas mkhas par mdzad de/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa bung+ngha pā li ta brtsams pa'i sgo nas thal 'gyur ba'i shing rta'i srol phye/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing ril bu'i dngos grub brnyes te rig 'dzin gyi gnas su gshegs/ legs ldan 'byed ni/ sde snod thams cad la mkhas shing*/ slob dpon dge 'dun srung las klu sgrub kyi gzhung rnams gsan/ phyag na rdo rje'i zhal gzigs shing*/ sangs rgyas bskyangs 'das pa na de'i 'grel ba gzigs te dgag pa mdzad nas rang rgyud kyi shing rta'i srol phye/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa shes rab sgron me sogs brtsams 'dis kyang ril bu'i dngos grub thob ste sku tshe phyi mar rig 'dzin gyi gnas su gshegs/ slob dpon 'di la slob ma paṇ+ḍi ta shin tu mang bas 'di'i lugs dar che/ 'di gnyis ma byon gong du klu sgrub thogs med gnyis kyis phye ba'i lugs mi mthun pa'i so sor gcod pa mi byed kyang*/ 'di gnyis byon nas de gnyis kyi lugs tha dad pa'o zhes so sor phye'o/

/slob dpon dkon mchog gsum gyi 'bangs ni/ slob dpon phyogs glang gi grogs po ste/ mkhyen pa yang gnyis ka mnyam par grags/ chos gzhi lnga bcu tsam btsugs shing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa byed par can mdzad do/ /dus 'dir dge bsnyen bzhi ba'i go cha zhes bya ba po ta lar phyin nas spyan ras gzigs kha sar pa ṇi lha lnga 'dzam gling dbus su spyan drangs pas dngos su byon/ de nas rgyal po ngang tshul zhes bya ba phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun thams cad bsdus nas mchod par byed pa zhig byung*/ rgyal po sed+ge zhes bya ba'i dus su slob dpon tsaṇ+ḍa go mi 'khrungs shing*/ lho phyogs su slob dpon zla ba grags pa byung*/ de las zla grags ni/ sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi slob ma zhig la klu sgrub kyi gzhung mtha' dag gsan pas/ mdo sngags thams cad dang 'phags pa'i lugs la mkhas pa'i phul byung du byung*/ nā lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad/ legs ldan 'das pa'i tshe des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa la gzigs pas/ des sangs rgyas bskyangs kyi 'grel pa skyon brjod mdzad pa rnams mi 'thad par rtogs nas/ rtsa she'i 'grel pa tshig gsal mdzad pa'i sgo nas skyon spangs te/ 'phags pa'i dgongs pa mthar thug sangs rgyas bskyangs dang mthun par bkral/ 'dus pa'i rgyud gyi 'grel pa sogs dang*/ 'jug pa sogs mdzad de 'phags pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs par bkral lo/ /chos rnams rang bzhin gyis med cing tha snyad du yod pa tsam du bshad pas 'ga' zhig na re/ de yin na'ang ba dngos dang ri mor bris pa'i ba la 'o ma bzho rgyu yod med khyad yod ces zer ba na/ ri mor bris pa'i ba drus ma las 'o ma dngos su bzhos nas dge 'dun la drangs/ rtsig pa sogs la thogs med du byon pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa mang du bstan/ mu stegs kyi rtsod pa mang po zlog /chos gzhi yang mang du btsugs/ tu ru ṣ+ka'i dmag byung ba na rdo'i sed+ge btang ste bzlog /'jam dbyangs kyi dngos su byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung bas mdo rgyud rig gnas gang la yang thogs pa med pa sogs dang*/

ring du bzhugs nas mthar sgyu lus grub bo/ /tsan+ḍa go mi ni/ tshe sngon ma spyan ras gzigs 'grub pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig ste/ des mu stegs rgyang pan pa zhig dang skye ba phyi ma yod med brtsad pas mu stegs pham kyang des skye ba phyi ma yod pa dngos su mi mthong zhes khas ma blangs pa'i tshe paṇ+ḍi ta des rgyal po sogs dbang du bzhag nas rtags mtshan btab ste rgyal rigs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gi bur skye ba bzhengs par khas blangs pa ltar skyes pa'i rtags mtshan de dag kyang dngos su byung nas rgyal po sogs skye ba phyi ma yod par yid ches/ skyes ma thag tu ma la phyag byas nas 'o brgyal bar gyur tam zhes smras pa na/ mas btsas ma thag gtam smra ba mi rigs kha rog sdod ces byas pa na lo brgyad kyi bar lkug pa ltar bsdad/ de'i tshe mu stegs kyi paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa zhig gis tshigs bcad gcig bris te rgyal po la byin nas 'di'i don shes mkhan gyi nang pa yod na kho bo dang rtsod/ med na nang pa rnams mu stegs par chugs ces byas pa na/ gzhan gyis ji lta ba bzhin ma shes/ slob dpon 'dis de'i don dkrol nas mu stegs pa de 'khor bcas/ nang par bcug pa'i lo rgyus rgyas pa ni gzhan du gsal/ rgyal bos bu mo byin kyang de la ma bsdad pa'i tshe rgyal pos sgrom du bcug nas chu bo gad+gā bskur/ slob dpon gyis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas mtsho 'gram nas 'thon te phyogs zhig tu bzhugs pas der grong khyer chags/ theg pa chen po'i chos gzhi mang du btsugs/ de nas nā lan+dar byon pas zla ba grags pa ra ba'i phyi rol na chos 'chad pa dang mjal te/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku shing rta'i nang du bzhugs/ g.yas g.yon du zla grags dang tsan+da go mi bzhugs te nang du 'byon pa'i tshe sku de la tsan+da go mis bstod pa phul bas sku de dbu g.yon phyogs la g.yon nas gsan 'phro la lus pas 'jam dbyangs dbu g.yon mar grags/

nang du byon nas tsan+ḍa go mi spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang zhig tu bzhugs nas thogs med ltar sems tsam pa'i lugs bzung*/ zla grags kyis klu sgrub kyi lugs bzung nas ring du brtsad/ zla grags kyis rtsod pa lan dka' ba dag bkod kyang*/ tsan+ḍa go mis 'phags pa la dris nas de'i lan thogs med du btab pas/ de la zla grags kyi lan gdab dka' ba ltar gyur pa na/ 'di la rtsod pa slob mkhan zhig yod 'dra bsams nas phyir 'brang ste sgo gseb nas bltas pas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku zhig yod pa de/ spyan ras gzigs su gyur te mdzub mos tsaṇ+ḍa go mi la slob dpon gyis slob ma la ston pa ltar slob pa gzigs/ 'phags pa nye ring mi mnga' 'am zhes zhus te sgo phye ba na/ de nyid rdo skur gyur nas mdzub mo ke re lus pas de la 'phags pa mdzub ker mar grags shing de'i tshe rtsod pa yang zhi/ zla grags kyis spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba btab pas mnal lam du gzigs shing*/ phyis bsgrubs pas zhal dngos su gzigs/ sgra mdo kun tu bzang po zhes pa tshig sbyor phun sum tshogs pa zhig mdzad de 'dir ma dar/ tsaṇ+ḍa go mis tsaṇ+ḍa pa zhes pa'i sgra mdo zhig mdzad pa 'phags bod gnyis kar dar che zhing*/ der bzo gnas dang*/ sgra dang*/ rtog ge /sman dpyad/ zlos gar/ sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod/ snyan ngag /skar rtsis sogs tha snyad rigs pa'i bstan bcos mang du mdzad nas slob ma rnams la gtso bor bshad pa'i tshe/ sgrol mas bskul te/ sa bcu ba dang ting nge 'dzin rgyal po dang*/ sdong po brgyan dang*/ laṅkar gshegs pa dang*/ sher phyin gyi mdo rnams gtso bor 'chad cing*/ snga ma rnams zhar byung byas spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rgya rtsa re brtsams/ dbul mo zhig gi bu mo mdzes ma zhig bag mar 'gro ba'i chas ka med nas slob dpon la spong mo byas pas/ snying rjes sgrol ma'i bris sku zhig la gsol ba btab pas de sgrol mar gyur te rin po che'i rgyan phud nas slob dpon la byin/

slob dpon gyis de la byin pas shin tu dga'o/ / de la sogs pa gzhan yang mang ngo*/ /rgyal po gsal bas ni zla grags sogs mchod cing*/ mu tig gis bkang ba'i gser bum brgya rtsa brgyad chos gzhi'i thebs su phul/ ma ga dha'i lha khang dang mchod rten rnams la mchod pa chen po byas/ rgyal po me tog ces pas kyang phyogs bzhir gtsug lag khang byas nas/ dge 'dun gyi sde mang po la mchod pa chen po mdzad/ chos gzhi nyi shu dang*/ mchod rten yang mang du bzhengs/ btsun pa grol sdes byams pa lo mang por bsgrubs pas 'grub/ de skabs su slob dpon dul ba'i sde byon te bstan bcos 'ga' re brtsams/ mi pham mgon po zhal gzigs nas de'i sku bzhengs/ de'i gsung nas sgrol sku bzhengs shig gsungs pa ltar bzhengs/ slob dpon yon tan blo gros ni rig gnas thams cad dang mngon pa la mkhas/ blo brtan gyi rjes su 'brang nas legs ldan 'gog pa'i 'grel pa yang byas/ slob dpon chos skyong ni/ mdo sde mang po la mkhas shing nam mkha'i snying po'i zhal gzigs/ byang sems kyi ltung ba byung ba rnams la nam mkha'i snying po'i drung du bshags su 'jug /nam mkha' mdzod las nor blangs nas dge 'dun la yo byas sbyar/ mu stegs byed pa dbyig sngon can gyi sgo nas dag non mdzad/ bcud len gyi dngos grub thob bo/ rgyal sras zhi ba lha ni/ rgyal po zhig gi sras su 'khrungs te rgyal srid la bsko bar brtsam pa na/ mnal lam du 'jal dpal dang sgrol mas bkag pa'i mtshan ma bstan pas/ mi rung bar shes te bros rtag tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing*/ grub pa'i rtags/ ral gri zhig gnang*/ rgyal po sid+ge lnga pa btul te nang pa'i chos gzhi nyi shu tshugs shig ces bsgos/ rab tu byung nas chos thams cad 'jam dpal la gsan nas thugs su chud kyang gzhan ngor mi mkhas pa'i tshul bstan te nyal nas bsdad pa ltar mngon/ gzhan dag gis thos bsam gang yang mi byed pa'i mi dad rdzas chud za ba 'di bskrad par bya'o zhes 'gros/

mdo 'don res byas na 'di rang bud la 'gro zhes zer te/ de ltar byas pas re zhig khas ma blangs/ nan cher brjod pas khas blangs/ de nas khri brtsaigs par bzhugs nas spyod 'jug brtsams/ shes rab le'u'i skabs su sku mi snang bar byas te rim gyis nam mkhar 'phur nas rdzogs pa na gzhan du gshegs/ de'i tshe bslab btus kyang sngar brtsams pa shes*/ yul gzhan zhig tu mu stegs zhig gi rgyal po la zhus te nang ba dang nus pa 'gran pa byas pa na/ gzhan gyis ma nus pas/ slob dpon gyis nus pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa mu stegs btul zhing rgyal po 'khor bcas chos la bkod do/ /mdor na ngo mtshar can gyi mdzad pa bdun bstan cing*/ 'di dang tsaṇ+ḍa go mi gnyis la gnas rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon gnyis zhes grags so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen ni/ sgrol ma zhal dngos su gzigs pa zhig ste longs spyod zad mi shes pa byung nas thams cad sbyin pa btang*/ rgyal po zhig gis log ltas mi brgya dang bdun slob dpon 'd-i dang bcas brgya rtsa nyos nas me la mchod sbyin byed pa na/ slob dpon 'dis sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas/ byon nas phyag nas char chen po babab te me zhi/ rgyal po ya mtshan skyes nas mi thams cad btang ste slob dpon la mchod/ yang sgrol ma la gsol ba btab pas des yul gzhan zhig tu 'khrid pa der sgrol ma'i lha khang chen po zhig bzhes nas chos bstan te mang po'i don byas/ dus 'di tsam nas grub ḍoṃ bi he ru ka dang*/ grub chen dril bu yang byung ste lo rgyus ni gzhan du gsal lo/ /de'i tshe su kha de ba zhes bya ba byung ste/ spyan ras gzigs bsgrubs pas zhal mthong ste grub pa thob bo/ /de nas rgyal po seṅge lnga ba'i dus su mu stegs kyi ston pa bram ze gzhon nu rol ba dang*/ gzeg ma sgra sgrogs ces pa gnyis byung ste/ de gnyis kyis nang ba la rtsod pa mang po byas pa na nang ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta de rnams kyis ma thub pas/

nang ba'i longs spyod mang po mu stegs byed la shor/ 'on kyang de'i rjes su slob dpon de wa shra ma zhes pas mu stegs 'ga' zhig pham par byas te bstan pa bcug ste lha khang dang*/ mchod rten mang po bzhengs/ chos gzhi yang btsugs so/ /dus der slob dpon chos kyi grags pa byon te/ chung ngu nas blo shin tu rno bas rig gnas mang po dang*/ mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad la sbyangs pas lo bco brgyad tshun la mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad la mkhas par gyur/ skabs zhig sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab 'ga' zhig gzigs pas dad de/ nang ba'i dge bsnyen gyi cha lugs su bsgyur ba na/ gzhan dag gis de ci yin dris pas/ nang pa'i bsngags pa brjod pas mu stegs pas bskrad/ 'dir cung mi 'dra ba zhig kyang 'byung*/ rab tu byung nas sde snod gsum la mkhas par byas/ phyogs glang gi slob ma dbang phyug sde la phyogs glang gi gzhung nyan pas don thams cad mkhyen/ he ru bsgrubs pas zhal mngon sum gzigs te/ phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i dngos grub byin/ lho phyogs su byon nas mu stegs kyi ston pa gzhon nu rol pa'i g.yog tu bzhugs nas mu stegs kyi grub mtha'i gsang tshig mtha' dag rtogs par byas te/ mu stegs la yon byin nas nub mo bros nas byon/ de nas rgyal po zhig gi sar sgo yig btab ste rtsod par 'dod pa su yod ces byas pas/ gzeg zan gyi grub mtha' 'dzin pa sogs mu stegs lnga brgya tsam 'dus pa dang zla ba gsum du brtsad pas/ thams cad rim gyis pham par bya ste bstan pa btsug /rgyal po dbang bsgyur te longs spyod can lnga bcu tsam gyis nang pa'i chos gzhi re btsugs/ gtam de gzhon nu rol bas thos nas 'ongs te brtsad pas/ slob dpon gyis de'i dam bca' thams cad re re nas rigs pa'i rnam grangs brgya brgyas bkag nas pham par byas te/ gzhon nu rol pa yang bstan pa la btsud/

'khor gyi bram ze thams cad kyang bstan pa la dad pa thob nas rab tu byung gzhan yang mu stegs kyi rtsod pa'i khyu mchog mang po rigs pas pham par byas/ dra ba li'i yul du byon nas rtsod nus pa yod dam dril bsgrags pas/ phal cher gzhan du bros/ 'ga' zhig gis rtsod mi nus par khas blangs nas der chos gzhi thams cad gsos te/ nags tshal zhig tu bsam gtan mdzad cing bzhugs pa las/ nā lan+dar dbang phyug chen po 'grub pa'i saṃ ga ā tsar+yas sad phod rtsod pa bya'o zhes dus btab/ rtsod pa'i dus su rgyal po rab gsal gyis wa ra ṇa sir dpang bo kun bsdus nas rgyal po sogs dpang bo tshogs dang bcas pa'i dbus su slob dpon dang de gnyis brtsad pas/ slob dpon gyis de lan mang du pham par byas te mthar cang mi smra ba'i gnas la bkod/ bstan pa la bzhugs byas kyang ma nyan par gad+gār mchongs nas shi ste/ kho rang gi slob ma bha dra ā tsar+ya'i bur skye ba blangs/ de'i slob ma mang po bstan pa la bcug / lhag ma mang po zhig ni thag ring du bros so/ /saṃ gha ā tsar+ya'i 'di skye ba len pa la dbang thob pa zhig yin 'dug pas gang zag khyad par can du sems/ bha dra ā tsar+ya zhes pa ni tshangs pa'i bu mos rjes su bzung nas sgra tshad la shin tu mkhas pas nang pa mang po dang brtsad nas de rnams pham par byas te/ nang ba'i chos gzhi mang po 'phrog /dge bsnyen mang po zhig mu stegs 'jug dgos pa byung*/ des kyang lo bdun lha mnyes par byas nas slob dpon dang brtsad pas slob dpon shin tu pham par byas te/ slob dpon gyis bzlog kyang ma nyan par chur mchongs nas shi/ der mu stegs drang po'i blo can lnga brgya ni bstan pa la rab tu byung*/ lnga brgya tsam ni dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro bar byas/ phal cher ni thag ring du bros so/ /gzhan yang bram ze gang ba dang gang ba bzang po zhes pa gnyis kyang rtog ge la shin tu mkhas shing*/

rang gi lhas byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ de gnyis snga phyir rtsod du 'ongs pa slob dpon gyis btul nas bstan la bzhugs/ de gnyis re res kyang chos gzhi lnga bcu re btsugs/ slob dpon dang 'di gnyis kyang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud nas lung bstan 'dug pas skyes chen dam pa'o/ /saṃ ga ā tsar+ya'i skye ba gnyis pa de sngon ma las kyang mkhas shing*/ dbang phyug bum pa'i khar lus rdzogs par bstan nas rigs pas slob par byed/ des kyang mang po'i dbus su slob dpon dang sngar bzhin brtsad pas pham ste ma nyan par chur mchongs nas shi/ yang bha dra ā tsar+ya'i brgyud du skye ba blangs/ de yang dang snga ma las blo rno zhing*/ dbang phyug chen po rang gi mdun du 'ongs nas rigs pa slob par mdzad/ des kyang slob dpon dang sngar ltar brtsad pas slob dpon gyis pham par byas nas nang par bcug ste des lha khang bzang po zhig bzhengs/ mu stegs mkhas pa 'ga' zhig drang po'i sems kyis slob dpon gyi mdun du 'ongs nas brgal brtag byas pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis yang dag pa'i rigs pa bstan pas dad de slob dpon gyi lugs dar bar byas/ de'i tshe slob dpon gyi snyan pa sa steng thams cad du khyab bo/ /slob dpon 'dis mu stegs bstan pa la bcug pa 'bum longs par grags/ de'i tshe phyogs gzhan du byon nas bstan pa'i 'gal rkyen rnams rtsod pas tshar bcad de nyams pa rnams gsos/ rgyal po dad pa can dang blon po sogs chos kyi sgo nas dbang du bsdus te dge 'dun gyi sde thug med du dar bar mdzad/ rang nyid kyis lha khang brgya rtsa bzhengs shing*/ gzhan la bskul te bzhengs pa ni grangs med do/ /phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du tshad ma sde bdun brtsams/ grub pa yang thob cing kun tu bzang po'i sprul bar grags/ mthar sku 'das pa'i tshe gdung zhugs la phul bas gdung thams cad mching bu 'dra ba'i gong bu gcig tu song ste rus pa'i rnam pa ye med la/

de'i dus ston gyi mchod pa da lta yang byed ces grags slob dpon 'di dang bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po dus mnyam zhes bshad/ 'di dus su grub chen lwa wa dang*/ in+d+ra bhu ta bar pa dang*/ slob dpon ku ku rā dza dang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes dang lā li ta sogs rim par byon zhing*/ de las mtsho skyes ni rgyal po zhig gis mer bsregs pa na der mtsho chung zhig tu he ru ka yab yum gyi skur dngos su gyur pa'i 'grub chen shig yin la gzhan rnams kyang bde mchog /dgyes rdor/ gshin rje gshed la sogs rigs kyi sgo nas grub pa chen po thob pa ste lo rgyus ni gzhan du gsal/ lā li tas 'jam dpal bsgrubs pa'i zhal gzigs te lung bstan pa ltar u rgyan nas gshin rje gshed nag po skor gyi rgyud rnams spyan drangs/ ye shes mkha' 'gro mas rjes su bzung zhing*/ phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes/ mngon spyod kyis/ mi dang mi ma yin gdug pa can mang po btul nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /grub chen bī ru pa ni rdo rje phag mos rjes su bzung zhing*/ /shin rje gshed dngos su gzigs nas de'i sgrub thabs kyang mdzad/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i rgyud spyan drangs/ nus pa che ba'i las tshogs kun la'ang thogs pa med/ da lta grub thob nyi ma 'dzin zhes grags pa de 'di yin par snang ngo*/ /de'i slob ma ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka ni ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas rjes su bzung zhing*/ dgyes rdor gyi sgrub thabs mdzad/ rgyud don mang po mngon shes mkhyen/ de'i tshe ka la go mi zhes bya ba spyan gzigs kyi grub thob zhig byung*/ chos kyi grags pa 'das pa na rgyal po go mi tsan+d+ra byung*/ de'i dus su grub chen dza yan+dha ri pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa gnyis kyis bder dgyes kyi sgo nas grub pa thob cing*/ bde mchog yab yum gnyis kyis rjes su bzung ba ste/ lo rgyus rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya la/

dza lan+dha ra ba 'di grub chen mthu nus byin rlabs shin tu che ba ngo mtshar can zhig go /nag po spyod pas gdul bya mang po bde dgyes kyi grub pa la bkod cing*/ 'khor ni stong dang bzhi brgya tsam rjes su 'brang la/ he ru ka'i gsung gis bskul te bde mchog gi skor mang du mdzad/ der grub chen dza lan+dha ri ba'i slob ma grub thob tan+ṭi pa yang byung ste/ rje btsun rnal 'byor mas dngos su byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung ba zhig yin la/ phyis phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub kyang thob bo/ /dus 'dir slob dpon dpal skyes dang de'i slob dpon ye shes snying po nyid kyang byon nas rang rgyud pa'i dbu ma'i lugs bzung*/ ye shes snying por spyan ras gzigs yid bzhin 'khor lo'i zhal gzigs/ dge bsnyen btsun pa ngo bo nyid med pa zhes bya bar 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs/ sgrol ma'i rig sngags kyang 'grub bo/ / de'i tshe slob dpon chos bshes byon te 'dul ba rgya cher 'grel brtsams/ skabs der mu stegs kyi rgol ba shin tu mang bar gyur nas/ nang ba rnams thugs 'tshab 'tshab por gnas dgos pa byung*/ 'dis zhwa rtse ring gyon nas mu stegs kyi rgol ba zhig brtsad pas rgyal ba na/ de phyin chad paṇ+ḍi ta rnams zhwa rtse ring gyon pa dar*/ rgyal po go sā la zhes bya bas lha mo tsun+da'i grub pa thob ste/ gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas dge 'dun gi sde mang du btsugs shing mchod pa chen po byas so/ /'di'i dus su slob dpon shākya 'od byung nas kha che'i yul du 'gro don cher mdzad/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa brtsams/ de'i tshe kha che'i yul du dā na shī chen po sogs 'dul 'dzin mkhan pa mang du byon/ de nas bī ru ba chung ba zhes pa grub pa brnyes pa zhig byung*/ mu stegs pa drang po'i rang bzhin can ro langs gser du bsgyur nus shing*/ ral gri dngos grub thob pa zhig kyang byung ste/

des ro langs gser du bsgyur ba nang ba'i dge bsnyen zhig la byin pas/ des gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs/ dge slong dang dge bsnyen lnga brgya re'i 'tsho ba sbyar/ ma shi'i bar chos gzhi gtsugs shing*/ 'chi ba'i tshe chos gzhi rgyal po gtad do/ /de nas rgyal po de ba pā la zhes bya ba byung ste/ 'dis dmag byas te mu stegs kyi lha khang mang po bshig nas nang pa la phan btags/ 'di'i ring la nag po spyod pa chung ba zhes bya ba byung ste/ bde dgyes gshin rje gshed dag sum la mkhas/ rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub chen po brnyes so/ /de la grub chen nag po spyod pa dang*/ nag po spyod pa chung ba dang*/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje gsum so so yin la/ de bzhin du in+d+ra bho dhi gsum/ sgra gcan 'dzin gsum/ mar me mdzad gsum/ dā ri ka pa la gnyis/ a mo gha badz+ra gnyis byung bas rnams ming 'dra yang gang zag so so ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon zhi ba 'tsho ni dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa'i gong der byon yang sku tshe ring bas rgyal po 'di'i bar du bzhugs zhes grags/ dbu ma'i srol bzung zhing*/ rgyal po khri srong sde btsan gyi dus su mkhan po mdzad/ dbu ma rgyan mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa dang khyad par du bod la bka' drin che/ 'di dus kha cher mche ba'i sde sogs byon/ slob dpon seng bzang yang byon te sher phyin dar ba byas pa ni grags che/ shākya bshes gnyen gyis de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa ko la'i rgyan mdzad/ gang blo ma mdzad mkhan gyi slob dpon rdo rje mtshon cha zhes de yang byon/ 'jam dpal grags pa zhes bya ba mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa mdzad po pa ste/ rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags ni min no/ /de'i tshe badz+ra de wa zhes bya ba spyan ras gzigs gyi zhal mngon sum mthong ba zhig byon te snyan ngag la mkhas par grags/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjer 'jam dpal gyis zhal gzigs shing*/

sngags kyi chos du ma dang*/ mtshan brjod gyi 'grel pa yang mdzad/ ma tang gi yang skabs 'dir byung bar bshad de rtag dgos par snang*/ ko ka na sa dang paṇ+ḍi ta sgra can 'dzin zhes pa gnyis byung ste 'phags bskor rnams dang ba tsam byas/ rgyal po dharmā pa la zhes pa zhig byung ste/ slob dpon seng bzang po bsten nas shes phyin dar bar byas/ chos gzhi spyir lnga bcu btsugs pa las/ sher phyin 'chad pa'i chos gzhi so lnga byas/ lha khang che chung brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ dge 'dun brgya bzhi bcu la rgyun du 'tsho ba sbyar nas skabs 'gar yon 'bul/ rgyal po de sher phyin dar bar mdzad pa'i smon lam 'grub pa zhig yin te/ sher phyin byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar lung bstan pa'i thog ma 'di yin par bshad do/ /gzhan yang rgyal po 'di'i dus su slob dpon rgya mtsho sprin dang*/ gang spel dang*/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs kyang byon/ rgya mtsho sprin gyis ni byams pa'i zhal gzigs shing*/ sa sde lnga la 'grel pa mdzad/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sku tshe'i stod la seng bzang bstan nas sher phyin la sbyangs shing*/ smad la 'jam dpal gyi zhal mngon sum gzigs nas dbang bskur te/ gsang 'dus lha bcu dgu ma sogs gnang zhing slob dpon nyid kyis kyang grol ba'i thig le sogs mdzad de/ rgyud sde mang po'i don bshad/ dzam+bha las nyin re bzhin gser pa ṇa bdun brgya re dang*/ nor rgyun mas mu tig gi do shal sum rgya re 'dul zhing*/ de thams cad dge ba'i phyogs la btang*/ khyad par gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la mar me sogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po rgyun mi chad du mdzad cing*/ lhag ma sbyin pa byas te rgyas par ni gzhan du gsal/ slob dpon gyi slob ma grub chen mar me mdzad kyang 'di dus byon te slob dpon 'di dang yon tan mnyam pa'i lo rgyus ni gzhan du shes/

slob dpon 'di'i slob ma rab zhi bshes gnyen gyis gshin rje gshed kyi zhal gzigs/ dzam+bha la 'grub nas slong ba po rnams tshim par mdzad/ gtsug khang bzang po zhig bzhengs/ mthar rig 'dzin gyi dngos grub thob/ rgyal rigs sgra gcan 'dzin zhes pas gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub par byas pa de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang*/ gsang bdag gi zhal dngos su gzigs/ gsang sngags mang du gsungs shing*/ 'dus pa'i lha khang chen po zhig bzhengs/ rig 'dzin grub cing klu 'dul ba'i ched du rgya mtshor byon nas da lta yang bzhugs par grags/ sangs rgyas zhi ba ni slob dpon 'di'i slob ma yin la/ gsang sngags kyi chos mang po dang*/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum la mkhas shing*/ rnal 'byor rgyud la brten nas grub pa thob/ spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas gsang bas ni 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs shing dngos grub brnyes/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang rnal 'byor rgyud la shin tu mkhas shing*/ de'i cho ga dang sgom tshul bshad/ 'di gnyis ka po tar byon nas sgrol ma rgan ma dang*/ spyan ras gzigs rdo sku'i rnam par mthong ba sogs kyi lo rgyus yod/ sgrol ma dang 'jam dpal gyis sangs rgyas gsang ba la ti sir sgrub pa gyis zhes bskul ba ltar mdzad pas rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen pos yang yang zhal gzigs/ 'jam dpal dang mi lab pa bzhin du gyur/ mi ma yin thams cad bran du bkol cing*/ las tshogs du ma la thogs pa med pa byung*/ bod kyi rgyal po khri srong sde btsan gyis bod du gdan 'dren la btang kyang 'jam dpal gyis 'byon du ma gnang*/ slob dpon ka ma shī la yang rgyal po 'di'i sku tshe'i smad la bod du byon te rgya nag hā shang gi lugs bkag cing*/ dbu ma'i sgom rim sogs mdzad/ rgyal po dharmā pā la'i sras zhig gi dus su slob dpon chos mchog dharma mi tra sogs slob dpon mang du byon/

de'i rjes su rgyal po ma hi pā la zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ 'di ni bod kyi rgyal po khri ral bzhugs pa'i dus dang rags par mnyam mo/ /'di'i dus su slob dpon kun dga' snying po sogs mang du byon zhing*/ grub chen te lo pa yang dus 'dir byon par mngon no/ /slob dpon kun dga' snying po ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing*/ khyad par du rnal 'byor rgyud la mkhas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha rnams kyi zhal gzigs nas bstan bcos rtsom par lung bstan thob/ lhag pa'i lha dang mi ltar gtam mdzad/ rig sngags kyi mthu grub pa las tshegs gang la'ang thogs pa med/ yi ge'i rgyud ni 'grel pa mang po mdzad nas sems can mang po'i don byas so/ /de tsam na slob dpon bha go zhes bya ba rdo rje bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i zhal gzigs pa zhig byung*/ he ru ka bsgrubs pas phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub thob/ de'i slob ma slob dpon bdud rtsi gsang bas gter gyis bum pa brgyad bsgrubs nas 'phongs pa rnams tshim par mdzad/ chos gzhi chen po'i brgyad btsugs/ de'i slob ma zhig gis kyang*/ ro langs kyi dngos grub thob/ /bum pa bzang po bsgrubs nas phyogs bzhi'i skye bo tshim par byas/ rigs lnga dang rdo rje bdud rtsi'i lha khang chen po yang bzhengs so/ /rgyal po ba hā pā la'i sras kyis dge slong lnga brgya dang*/ chos ston pa lnga bcu la rgyun du 'tsho ba sbyar/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mang por mchod/ gtsug lag khang dang*/ chos gzhi yang mang po byas/ rgyal po de'i sku tshe'i smad tsam nas bi ṭo ā tsar+yas dus 'khor spyan drangs nas dang bar mdzad/ shes 'byung sbas pa dang*/ dze ta ri dang*/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje dang*/ slob dpon tha ga na sogs byon/ dus 'khor zhabs kyang 'di dus byon par mngon/ de la slob dpon dzi ta ri rgyal po pa na pa la'i dus su byung ste/

rgyal po de la btsun mo mdzes ma zhig yod pa de dang gser dang*/ glang po che la sogs pa slob dpon snying po'i zhabs la gsang 'dus kyi dbang zhus pa'i yon du phul ba las 'khrungs/ 'jam dbyangs bsgrubs pas rjes su bzung ste byin gyis brlabs pas tha snyad pa'i rig gnas rnams ni bslab ma dgos par shes/ rig gnas 'ga' zhig dang mdo rgyud rnams la lan cig bltas pa tsam gyis mkhyen te mkhas pa'i dbang por gyur/ 'jam dpal las dngos su chos mang du gsan/ sgrol mas kyang mngon sum du zhal bstan/ mu stegs kyi rtsod pa bzlog pas slob dpon dgra las rnam rgyal du grags/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mang po'i dgongs 'grel mdzad/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje dgyes pa rdo rje dkyil 'khor mngon sum du gzigs shing*/ nus pa dpag tu medapa yang brnyes so/ /rgyal po ma hā pā la'i sku tshe'i smad tsam nas mkhas pa sgo drug gi tha snyad kyang byung*/ nā lan+da dang*/ bi kram shrī la'i shar sgo srung ba slob dpon chen po'i shan+ti pa ni/ mdo rgyud dang rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/ byams pa dang*/ 'jam dbyangs/ sgrol ma/ rje btsun rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs/ mdo sngags gnyis kyi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos brtsams pa ni shin tu mang ste/ 'phags yul gyi mkhas grub bstan bcos mdzad mkhan rnams gyi nang nas slob dpon 'dis mdzad pa las mang ba ma mthong*/ 'phags yul nam mkhas pa'i dbang por grags shing*/ mu stegs kyi rtsod pa shin tu mang po bzlog pas/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zhes rgyal po sogs kyis sngags/ grub pa brnyes shing sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas yang 'dis mdzad dai grags che'o/ /lho sgo srung ba sher 'byung blo gros ni/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/ 'jam dpal gyis zhal mngon sum gzigs pa zhig ste/ mu stegs dang rtsod pa'i tshe 'jam dpal gyi bris sku zhig yod pa de la gsol ba btab pa na/

mu stegs kyis ji ltar zer ba dang*/ de'i lan 'debs tshul cig car thugs la shar nas/ sang rtsod pa'i tshe nges par rgyal ba zhig 'ong ngo*/ /nub sgo srung ba slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa ni/ mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas shing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor pa'i lha tshogs zhal gzigs nyi ma rer tshigs bcad stong re re'i tshad kyi gzhung gi tshig blo la 'dzin nus shing*/ don kun mkhyen pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug chen po grub pas 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la'ang thogs pa med/ sgrol mas rtag par zhal gzigs shing*/ the tsom gcod/ yul sna tshogs su byon pa nas mu stegs kyi rgol ba mang po tshar bcad cing*/ nub phyogs kho na nas 'ongs pa'i rgol ba sum brgya tsam sun byung*/ tshogs bdag las nor blangs nas dge 'dun mang po la mchod/ sher phyin 'chad pa'i chos gzhi brgya/ 'dus pa'i chos gzhi bzhi/ bde dgyes gdan bzhi'i chos bzhi re re/ dbu tshad kyi chos bzhi thor bu mang po btsugs/ bcud len gyi dngos grub 'grub nas gzhan la gnang*/ rgan po'i lus gzhon lus su bsgyur/ rab byung dang khyim pa chos ldan lnga brgya tsam la phan btags/ mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bshad/ mthar sgyu lus grub ste da lta yang bzhugs so/ /bod kyi lo rgyus 'gar lho sgo srung bar grags na'ang 'dir nub sgo srung ba'i lugs ltar ro/ /byang sgo srung ba'i nā ro pa ni/ grub chen te lo bas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i lo rgyus ni gzhan du gsal la/ 'dis bde mchog gi sgo nas grub pa thob cing*/ bde gsang gnyis rgyud don man ngag tu blangs pa 'phags yul dang*/ bod kyi mar ba lo tsa sogs la bshad pa'i srol da lta dar che ba 'di bzhin te bod kyi sngags phyogs kyi chos rgyud la phan chen po'i btags pas bka' drin che/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas kyang byin gyis brlabs shing mthar spyod pa la gshegs nas dngos grub mchog mnyes zhes grag go

/nā ro pa'i rjes su byang sgo srung bar gnas brtan byang bzang gi mdzad de/ 'di ni spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal dngos su gzigs pa zhig go /dbus kyi ka chen dang po rdo rje rin chen ni 'khor lo sdom pa dang rdo rje phag mo sgrub pas zhal gzigs/ tshad ma sde bdun dang*/ byams chos sogs la shin tu mkhas/ mu stegs mang po'i rtsod pa bzlog nas bstan pa la bcug go /ka chen gnyis pa dz+nya na shrī mi tra ni sde snod gsum la mkhas shing*/ gsang sngags kyi chos mang po yang mkhyen/ ston pa dang byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs/ mngon shes kyang thogs med mnga'/ jo bo rje'i bla ma sku drin che ba zhig yin/ chos gzhi mang po zhig btsugs/ jo bo rje yang 'di dus su byon te nā lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad cing*/ o tan+ta pu ri yang bskyangs/ phyis bod du byon pa'i lo rgyus ni grags che/ mi tri pa yang 'di dus su byon te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal gzigs shing grub pa brnyes pa'i lo rgyus ni gzhan du gsal/ de'i tshe a mo gha badz+ra dang*/ bla ma mngon shes can dang*/ pradz+nya rak+ṣi ta sogs mang du byon/ ḍoṃ bhi ba phyi ma ni nā ro pa'i slob ma yin te/ he ru ka'i grub pa brnyes/ ka so ri pas ni rdo rje phag mo zhal gzigs shing nus pa che/ ri ri ba ni nā ro pa'i slob ma ste/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i grub pa thob cing nags kyi srog chags gdug pa can stag sogs bkug nas chibs nus/ 'di gnyis ka'ang 'ja' lus su gshegs/ nā ro pa'i slob ma pradz+nya rak+ṣi ta ni rgyud sde kun dang bde mchog gi skor la lhag par mkhas/ bde mchog /'jam dpal/ dus 'khor sogs lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ lan gcig mu stegs kyi rgol ba brgyad rtsod du 'ongs pa la lta stangs mdzad pas drug ngag lkugs/ gnyis mig long yang slar grol bar mdzad/ slob dpon dpe med 'tsho ba ni/ rig gnas thams cad dang dus 'khor la mkhas/

spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mthong*/ phyag chen gyi dngos grub thob/ 'di dus su ya ma ri zhes pa byung ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta yin yang 'byor ba chung bas nor rgyu?n ma bsgrubs pa'i 'grub ste 'byor ba chen po byung*/ bram ze dga' byed ces bya ba tshang ma la shin tu mkhas pa zhig byung ste/ chos grags kyi lugs 'gog pa'i tshad ma gsar pa zhig bya'o snyam pa na/ 'jam dbyangs kyis rmi lam du chos kyi grags pa ni 'phags pa yin pas khyod kyi dgag mi nus/ skyon du mthong ba de khyed rang gi blo skyon yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ bshags pa phul nas chos grags kyi dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos brtsams/ rgyal po a mra pā la'i dus su slob dpon rat+na ā ka ra gup+tas rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po mdzad de/ skyes mchog ngo mtshar can zhig yin/ 'di'i rjes su paṇa grub che phra mang po byon/ grags che ba slob dpon a bh+ya ka ra ste/ 'di mdo rgyud thams cad la mkhas shing*/ rmi lam du rdo rje rnal 'byor mas zhal gzigs nas saṃ bhu ṭi'i ṭ+rik+ka mdzad pa'i gnas pa thob/ rdo rje'i gdan dang*/ bi kra ma shrī la dang*/ nā lan+da'i mkhan po mdzad/ sher phyin gyi dgongs 'grel dang*/ 'od snye sogs phreng ba gsum gyi skor sogs mang du mdzad de bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher byas/ 'di dus su bi kra ma shī la paṇ+ḍi ta drug cu tsam dang*/ rgyun du dge slong gzhan stong re tsam dang*/ mchod pa byed pa sogs kyi dus su rab byung lnga stong tsam re 'du/ rdo rje gdan du rgyal pos 'tsho ba sbyar ba'i theg chen pa bzhi bcu re dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun nyis brgya re rtag tu bzhugs shing*/ skabs 'gar dge slong khri phrag re tsam tshogs pa 'byung*/ o tan+ta dang pu rir rgyun du dge slong stong phrag re dang*/ skabs 'gar rab byung stong phrag bcu gnyis re 'byung bar grags so/ /slob dpon 'di la rgyal pos sa cha bzang po zhig kyang phul/

'di'i rjes su slob dpon chen po rat+na rak+ṣi ta dang*/ dz+nya na ā ka ra gub+ta sogs mkhas pa du ma byon zhing*/ de la grags che ba ni paṇa chen shākya shrī ste/ 'di ni sgrol mas rjes su bzung zhing mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol du phyin pa'o/ /phyis bod du byon nas don mdzad cing*/ de yang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta bzhugs pa'i skabs su yin no/ /slob dpon rat+na rak+ṣi ta ni/ mkhyen rab shākya shrī dang mnyam zhing*/ bde mchog /dus 'khor/ gshin rje gshed sogs lha mang po'i zhal gzigs/ dbang bskur ba'i tshe ye shes pa dngos su 'bebs nus/ gtor ma mkha' 'gros dngos su len/ sta stangs yang grub pa sogs mang ngo*/ /dz+nyā na ā ka gub+tas ni byams pa'i zhal gzigs/ bud+dha shrī mi tras ni mnal lam du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las chos gsan/ phyag ris kyang glang chen gnon nus/ de gnyis ka'ang rig gnas kun la mkhas shing*/ rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can brnyes pa'o/ /'di dag gi dus rgyal po se na bzhi byung ste/ de'i ring la phyogs kun tu mu stegs je 'phel du song zhing*/ kla klo'i grub mtha' 'dzin pa yang je mang du gyur/ de'i rjes su tu ru ṣ+ka'i rgyal po zhig byung ste/ des tu ruṣ+ka'i rgyal phran gzhan dang lhan cig tu ma ga dha'i yul thams cad bcom/ o tan+ta pu rir rab byung mang po bsad nas de dang bi kra ma shrī la gnyis cig car du bshig paṇ+ḍi ta rnams phyogs gzhan du bros te de gnyis su bstan pa nub bo/ /'di jo bo rje bi kra ma shrī la'i mkhan po mdzad nas bla rabs bcu pa paṇa chen shākya shrīs de'i mkhan po mdzad rjes su byung bar bshad do/ /de dus su grub thob 'ga' re yod kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi las bzlog thabs ma rnyed par/ yul gyi dbus ma ga dhar bstan pa nub pa ltar song ngo*/ /de'i rjes su rgyal po tsa ga la rā dza zhes pa zhig byung ste/

des rdo rje'i gdan du mchod pa chen po byas/ sngar bshig pa'i lha khang phal cher la zhig gsos dang*/ chos gzhi yang btsugs/ nā lan+dar lha khang la mchod pa chen po byas kyang chos gzhi ma tshugs/ rgyal po de phyin chad ma ga dhar mchod pa byed pa'i rgyal po ma byung zhing*/ sde snod 'dzin pa yang ma byung ngo*/ /phyis rgyal po mu ku de bas phyogs gzhan zhig tu lha khang bzhengs nas chos gzhi 'ga' re btsugs so/ /de phyin chad phyogs 'ga' re na bstan pa la bya ba byed pa'i rgyal po dang*/ mkhas grub 'ga' yod na'ang yul dbus su grags che ba ni med do// //༈ gnyis pa thob ru 'ga' zhig bshad par bya ste/ rgyal po pu rak+ṣi ta'i dus su laṅka rgyal bzang byon te/ sde snod thams cad la mkhas shing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal gzigs/ nus pa chen po thob/ de'i rjes su grub chen dpal 'dzin byon te/ gshin rje gshed kyi sgo nas grub pa thob/ dbyangs can ma'i zhal gzigs/ dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa zhig tu ru ṣ+ka'i rgyal pos mgo gcod par brtsom pa las slob dpon 'dis rang gi dbu byin te bslus nas/ rang gi ske la ma he'i mgo 'byar ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan no/ /de'i rjes su bha wa bha dra byon te/ sde snod thams cad la mkhas shing khyad par du rnam rig pa'i grub mtha' dang*/ ma rgyud la mkhas/ 'khor lo sdom pas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs/ ril bu'i dngos grub 'grub bo/ /de ni rjes su skal ldan grags pa byon te/ gsang sngags la shin tu mkhas shing*/ mngon shes brnyes so/ de rjes li la badz+ra byung ste/ gshin rje gshed kyi grub pa brnyes/ de rjes mi thub zla ba byon te/ gsang sngags kun dang 'dus pa la mkhas shing dngos grub brnyes/ de nas ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta byon te/ gshin rje gshed dang bde mchog la mnga' brnyes/ dud 'gro sogs kyi skad dang ma slob pa'i bstan bcos mang po rang shes su byung*/

de'i 'og tu bho dhi bha dra byung ste/ gsang sngags kun la mkhas shing*/ 'jam dpal gyi zhal gzigs/ de rjes ka ma la rak+ṣi ta byon te/ mdo rgyud kun dang*/ sher phyin dang gsang 'dus la lhag par mkhas// gshin rje gshed zhal gzigs nas thags kar thim/ 'jam dpal las chos du ma gsan te grub pa brnyes/ ma ga dha dmag gis bcom pa'i tshe dbus kyi mkhas pa phal cher shar phyogs su bros nas rgya mtsho dang nye bar rgyal po zhig gi yul du gnas pa na/ rgyal po des lha khang mang du bzhengs nas chos gzhi yang mang po btsugs shing*/ bstan pa dar bar byas/ de'i rgyun la phyis su dge 'dun khri phrag gnyis gsum longs zhes grags/ gzhan yang ko ki'i yul dang*/ gser gling*/ zangs gling sogs gling phran rnams su snga mo nas bstan pa dar zhing*/ de'i rgyun da lta'i bar yang yod ces gsungs/ sed+ga lar ston pa'i zhabs rjes kyi dus ston gyi tshe dge slong stong phrag bcu gnyis re 'dus te phar cher nyan thos so/ /ma ga dha tu ruṣ+ka bcom pa'i rjes su lho phyogs ka liṅka dang*/ ri bo 'big byed sogs su bstan pa dar nas rgyun da lta yang yod par grag go ༈ /gzhan yang sngon rgyal po longs spyod skra bzang sogs gsum gyi ring la gser 'gyur gyi rtsi 'grub ste slong ba po su byung yang sbyin pa rgya chen byas/ yang rgyal po gsum las cig gis lha khang che chung stong phrag lhag bzhengs/ gcig gis dge slong stong phrag re rgyun du mchod/ gcig gis bram ze khri phrag re dang*/ sangs rgyas pa khri phrag re la rgyun du chos ston byed/ rgyal po gzhon nu gdong drug ces bya bas nor rgyun ma grub ste/ dbul po thams cad la gos re dang*/ zas kyis lo nyi shur tshim par byas/ rgyal po dbang chen bu tsha bo'i ring la bram ze'i skye bo rnams dkon mchog gsum kho na mchod par bka' bsgos nas mchod/ bu gnyis kyis lha khang lnga bcu re bzhengs/
