bram ze pā la mi tra zhes bya ba zhig gis rgya mtsho'i mthar thug par mchod rten gyis gang bar byas te/ 'di ni 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du lung bstan/ bram ze nā ga ke ru zhes bya bas ston pa'i sku 'bum phrag gcig bzhengs nas re re la yang yo byad bcu res mchod/ bram ze 'grel ba'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba'i glegs bam stong phrag bcu bzhengs nas/ re re la yang mchod pa'i yo byad bco lnga res mchod/ glegs bam la lta ba'i dge slong dang dge bsnyen stong phrag dag la rtag tu 'tsho ba sbyar/ theg chen gyi slob dpon ni gag+ga ri zhes bya ba gzhan sems shes pa zhig gis chos bstan nas slob ma stong gi bzod pa thob/ de lta bu'i dge bsnyen zhig gis chos bstan nas dge bsnyen stong phrag mang pos sher phyin gyi don rtogs/ yang dge bsnyen blo gros gzhon nu zhes bya ba zhig gis chos bstan nas gdul bya khri khrag tsam bsam gtan par gyur/ dge slong bha dra zhes pas bden tshig kho na brjod de grong dang grong khyer gyi nang gdon zhi bar byas/ dge bsnyen dā na bha dra dang*/ laṅka re ba zhes bya ba gnyis kyis mchod rten dang sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs ri mo bris pa dang*/ rdo shing sogs las stong phrag mang po bzhengs nas re rer yang mchod pa'i rnam grangs rgyal mtshan bcu re phul/ yang dge bsnyen hu byu dze zhes bya bas 'bru dang gser dang zas gos sogs slong ba kun la byin/ mthar thams cad btang ste bsgoms pa'i mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas lus de nyid kyis bde ba can du song zhes grag /dge bsnyen dbu ma'i blo gros zhes bya ba byung ste/ mu stegs so so'i nang du song nas de dag dang 'dra ba'i gzugs sprul te/ de dang de'i bstan bcos bshad pa'i zhor la bdag med dang snying rje chen po bstan pas/ ma tshor bzhin du grub mtha' nang par bsgyur te/ tshul des mu stegs khri phrag sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bcug go

/slob dpon phyi ma 'di dag ni klu sgrub kyi sngon tsam du byung ba mngon la/ 'ga' zhig ni theg chen dar ba nas chos grags yan chad du byung bar sems na'ang*/ dus ji lta ba bzhin bsgrigs dka'o/ /de dag ni 'phags yul gyi gtam brgyud las byung ba ltar bkod kyi/ gzhan du mkhas grub mtha' dag gi byon tshul tshad bzung dka' ste/ 'phags yul du mkhas grub gzhan dpag tu med pa byon pa'i phyir dang*/ khyad par du klu sgrub kyi dus su sgrol ma'i sngags kyi grub thob stong phrag lnga tsam dang*/ rgyal po dā ri ka pa'i 'khor du stong phrag dang*/ nag po spyod pa'i 'khor du grub pa brnyes pa brgya phrag mang po bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa 'phros don la/ sngon dus rgyun zhugs dang*/ phyir 'ong dang*/ phyir mi 'ong dang*/ dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu bzhi thob pa mang po dang*/ grub pa thob pa yang mang du byung 'dug cing*/ da lta ni de 'dra dkon pa 'di ci yin snyam na/ dpyod ldan la de'i lan mdor bsdus zhig bshad par bya ste/ de ni spyir gong du brjod pa ltar dus kyi 'gyur ba'i chos nyid kyis yin te/ de yang bskal pa dang po'i sems can nas bzung ste rim gyi tshe dang las stobs bri nas tshe lo brgya dang*/ mthar tshe lo bcu ba la thug gi bar du 'gyur ba 'ong zhing*/ de la sngon gyi gdul bya rnams ni gtso cher rgyud dbang po tshogs te smin pa gsum shes che zhing*/ las nyon mongs rnam smin gyi sgrib pa gsum shas chung bas/ de dag gi rgyud la sa lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can skye sla bar ma zad/ chos ston pa po sangs rgyas sogs 'phags pa'i gang zag chen po de rnams kyi byin rlabs dang mthu nus kyang myur du skye bar 'ong la/ da lta'i gdul bya rnams las 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ smin pa gsum shas chung zhing sgrib pa gsum shas che bas sa lam gyi yon tan khyad par can rnams skye shin tu dka' ba yin pa'i phyir ro/

/'phags bod gnyis yul gyi dbang du byas na'ang mi 'dra ste/ 'phags yul ni sangs rgyas byang sems sogs 'phags pa'i gang zag mang po dngos su byon nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas yin zhing*/ de las kyang u rgyan gyi yul ni dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa zhig dngos su bzhugs pa'i gnas yin pas/ de rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs dang rjes su 'dzin pa myur ba las kyang sa lam gyi rtogs pa skye sla bas smin cing grol ba myur/ bod yul sogs ni khyad chos rnams dang bral bas na smin cing grol dka' ba'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas byon nas klu sgrub kyi gong de'i bar du 'bras bu bzhi thob pa mang zhing de'i rjes nas chos kyi grags pa yan chad du ni 'ga' re byung yang sngon ltar mang po med la/ chos grags man chad la 'bras bu bzhi thob pa ni re gnyis las mang du 'byung bar grags so/ /dgra bcom pa sa ga'i lha ni phyogs glang bzhugs pa'i tshe byon la/ sngon bod 'dir mnga' ris su dgra bcom pa zhig byung bar bshad do/ /'bras bu bzhi thob pa nyung du song ba na sngags la brten pa'i grub thaub rnams byon te/ de yang jo bo rje/ yan chad du mang po byon pa sngar bshad pa ltar yin la/ de 'das pa nas mang du ma byung ngo*/ /des na bod du grub pa thob pa ni sngon 'ga' re byung yang phyis dkon zhing*/ rje yab sras lta bu gang zag khyad par can gdul bya'i don du bsam bzhin du byon pa mang du snang ba rnams kyi tshod bzung dka'o/ /da lta 'bras bu bzhi gang rung thob pa dang*/ grub pa brnyes pa dkon yang mdo sngags kyi chos tshul bzhin nyams su blang nas sa lam sna re rgyud la skyes pa dang*/ nyams su len pa la brtson pa rnams ni da lta'i dus la sngon gyi dam pa rnams dang cha mtshungs pa'i gang zag khyad par can du bzung dgos so/ /de yang dus kyi dbang yin pas chos la log lta byar mi rung zhing*/

de bzhin du da lta'i dus su skyes chen dam pa mang du 'byung yang sngon ltar mi gsal ba ni dus kyi dbang yin pa'i khyad par yang shes dgos so/ /sngon 'phags yul du dkyil 'khor chen po la brten nas grub pa brnyes pa mang zhing*/ 'dus pa bde dgyes gshin rje gshed rnams kyi rnal 'byor pa mang la/ lha re re nas rjes su bzung ba la/ 'jam dbyangs/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma dang*/ de las 'jam dbyangs dang sgrol ma gnyis dang*/ lhag tu sgrol mas dngos su rjes su bzung ba mang bar mngon no/ /mu stegs kyi lha la tshangs pa dang dbang phyug dang khyab 'jug sogs mang yang*/ de'i mkhas grub phal cher dbang phyug yum dang tshangs pa'i bu mo dbyangs can mas rjes su bzung ngo*/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo las/ dbang phyug chen po ni spyan ras gzigs kyi dpral ba dang dbyangs can ma de'i tshems las sprul par bshad cing gzhan nas u ma sgrol ma'i sprul bar bshad 'dug pas/ sangs rgyas kyis sems can gyi don mdzad tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir de la smad du mi rung ste/ mdo las nga dang nga 'dra bas gang zag tshod bzung gi /gang zag gis gang zag gi tshod mi bzung ste zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /mu stegs kyi chos lugs ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'jig rten du ma byon pa'i gong nas byung ba yin te/ ston pa'i dus su mu stegs kyi ston pa drug sogs byung ba mdo las bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /mu stegs kyi chos lugs ni ston pa dang bstan pa dang lta ba gsum gyi sgo nas chos 'di las phyi rol tu gyur pa yin te/ dkon mchog la skyabs su mi 'gro zhing*/ bstan pa gzhan yin pa dang*/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba khas mi len pa'i phyir ro/ /mu stegs 'tshe ba chos su smra ba yod kyang*/ nang pa dang thun mong ba'i nyams len yod de/ sbyin gtong byed pa sogs dang*/ srog gcod spong ba dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/

gzugs med kyi snyoms 'jug sgom pa dang*/ sgra rig pa dang*/ gso ba dang*/ gzo dang*/ gtan tshigs rig pa la thos bsam byed pa sogs kyang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gtan tshigs rig pa la thun mong ba yod kyang*/ phal cher ni kho rang gi lugs thun mong ma yin pa mang ste de ni nang ba'i gtan tshigs rig pa dag dang mi 'dra bas 'gog pa na tshul 'dis 'gog pa yin no/ /kla klo'i chos lugs ni phyis byung ba ste/ 'tshe ba chos su smra zhing log chos yin yang*/ rgyal ba'i lugs dang mthun pa mang la/ da lta ni rgya gar na lugs de gnyis ka dar nas yod ces bshad do/ /bod du de gnyis kyi lugs mtshan nyid pa med kyang*/ sngon bon po dkar nag phra gsum byung zhing*/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis dus su dkar po'i lugs ma gtogs nag khra gnyis bsnubs kyang*/ de'i rgyun lus pa 'ga' zhig dang dkar po ni phyogs de dang 'di phyogs su'ang byung ngo*/ /bod du ni gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis ka dar zhing*/ gsang sngags snying ma'i lugs ni/ gtso cher u rgyan rin po che nas brgyud der byon la/ de ni gdul bya mang po zhig gi don du 'gyur ba'i chos lugs bye brag pa yin pas smad du mi rung yang*/ rgyal ba'i gsang sngags kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs ni gsar ma'i lugs bu ston rin po che dang*/ rje yab sras kyis bkral ba ltar yin par rnam dpyod can gyis rtogs te/ de'i phyir rang cag rnams kyi tshul de la 'jug pa yin no/ /sngon dus theg pa che chung gnyis dang grub mtha' bzhi so so dang*/ sde pa bco brgyad kyi lugs so sor ma 'dres par byung zhing gnas la/ phyis pha cher ni dbye med par theg chen gyi lugs gnyis ci rigs dang gcig tu 'dres nas lag len du byed de/ dper na/ sngags la zhugs ma zhugs gnyis kas gsang sngags kyi chos 'don pa dang*/ 'dul ba'i lugs ltar so thar nyams su len pa bzhin no/

/de'i dang po ni rnam dbye ma byung ba yin la/ phyi ma ni shes na 'os shing 'thad pa yin no/ /de dag ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzam gling 'di'i dbus dang*/ bod yul du byung ba'i dbang du byas la/ 'dzam gling gi byang phyogs sham+bha yar chos rgyal rig ldan rim pa byon pa dang 'byon pa rnams kyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba'i rgyun da lta'ang dar bzhin pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag tu'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa brgyud mar 'byung ba'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang de'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad de/ gser 'od las/ sangs rgyas mya ngan yod mi 'das/ /chos kyang nub par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang*/ rgyud blar yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes dang*/ rgyan las kyang*/ de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid 'di'i/ las ni rgyun mi chad par 'dod/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na byams pa'i bstan pa dus nam gyi tshe 'byung zhe na/ mi rnams kyi tshe lo bcu pa nas yar 'phel te/ tshe lo brgyad khri thub pa 'ong*/ da nas ring zhig nas mar 'grib pa'i dus su byams pa nyid 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul ston te/ de yang shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo bye ba phrag lnga bcu rtsa bdun nas 'byung bar bshad pa ltar ro/ /'on kyang byams pa'i sprul pa mang pos sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni/ tshe lo yar 'phel ba'i skabs zhig nas kyang 'byung bar bshad pa ltar shes dgos so// //༈ gsum pa bod du byung tshul mdor bsdus te brjod na/ bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma ni rje gnya' khri btsan po ste/ de ni rgya gar nas bod du byon pa mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal brgyud do/ /de la sogs pa gnam gyi khri bdun/ bar gyi steng gnyis dang legs drug /sa'i lde brgyad/ 'og gi btsan bzhi ste gdung rabs nyer bdun rim par byon pa'i dus su bod rnams sgrung lde'u bon po rnams ky-is bskyangs pa'i rjes su/

tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su za ma tog sogs nam mkha' nas babs te dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su/ yi ge'i srol gtod cing dge bcu'i khrims bcas/ mdo rgyud kha shas bsgyur/ lha sa khra 'brug sogs su lha khang brgya rtsa brgyad bzhengs/ jo bo rnam gnyis spyan drangs nas bstan pa'i srol phye/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ mkhan slob gnyis sogs rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta mang po spyan drangs nas mdo sngags kyi chos mang po bsgyur/ bsam yas kyi lha khang rten dang bcas pa bzhengs nas bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad/ de'i sras mu ne btsan pos lha khang 'ga' re bzhengs khri ral pa can gyis ka cog zhang gsum la brten nas gsung rab rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ mchod gnas rab byung re re la mi khyim bdun phul/ dge 'phel lha khang chen po bzhengs/ byang chub 'od kyi dus su jo bo rje dang 'brom ston sogs byon nas bka' gdams kyi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ de rjes lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab dang*/ skyes mchog rin chen bzang po sogs byon nas chos mang du bsgyur/ de nas sa skya gong ma rnams byon nas mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ de rjes bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa byon te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa zung 'brel lhag par dar bar byas/ de'i rjes su rje bdag nyid chen po yab sras sogs byon nas rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rnam par dag pa rgya mtsho'i mtha' la thug gi bar nyi ma ltar gsal bar mdzad/ rjes sras paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyis bkra shis lhun po btab nas gtsang phyogs su rje'i bstan pa dar zhing de nas paṇa chen sku snga phyi dang*/ rgyal dbang snga phyi rnams rim par byon te rje'i bstan pa lhag par dar bar byas/ phyis su sdai srid rin po che sangs rgyas rgya mtsho byon nas po ta la'i lha khang rten brten pa mang po dang*/

gser gdung chen mo bzhengs shing*/ be dkar brtsams pa sogs kyi sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ rje'i bstan pa rgya bod hor gsum gyi gnas kun tu dar zhing*/ khyad par du co ne'i dgon 'dir yang dpon gong ma'i dus nas da lta'i bar du dar ba las/ phyis ko'u shri nang so ye shes kyis mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan btsugs pa'i tshe/ smon lam gyi 'brel bas kho bos mdo sngags gnyis kyi slob dpon pa byas te thos bsam sgom gsum spyi dang*/ bye brag tu mdo sngags kyi bshad pa dang*/ rtsom pa ci nus byas pa'i sgo nas bstan pa la bya ba cung zad bgyis khul yin no/ /smras pa/ de ltar sngon gyi rgyal po'i rabs nyid dang*/ bstan 'dzin dam pa rim brgyud nyi 'od kyis/ /'dzin ma'i khyon kun gsal dang lhan cig tu/ /phan bde'i pad+mo'i tshal rab 'dzum par byas/ /tshul de mthong nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ /bya ba byas pa'i chos rgyal paṇa grub sogs/ /rim par byon pa'i bka' drin dran gso'i ched/ /rnam thar chos 'byung 'di ko bdag gis bris/ /dai yang rang bzo tsam ma yin par/ /dam pa gong ma'i gtam rgyud las/ /'byung ba du ma phyogs gcig tu/ /bsgrigs nas nyung ngu'i dag gis smras/ /de las thob pa'i rnam dkar dges/ /skye kun dam pa'i mgon nyid kyis/ /'bral med rjes bzung dam pa'i chos/ /'dzin cing sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa bshad sgrub ces bya bas co ne'i dgon ny-i+id du dad pas sbyar ba'o// mad+ga lam//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal rabs dang 'brel ba'i rgya bod kyi chos 'byung dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs/ -PAGE 176--PAGE 177--PAGE 134-
